text.body: <1> śrīnāradapañcarātram prathamaikarātre prathamo'dhyāyaḥ oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya atha maṅgalācaraṇam nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamaṃ | devīṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva tato jayaṃ udīrayeth || gaṇeśaśeṣabrahmeśadineśapramukhāḥ surāḥ | kumārādyāśca munayaḥ siddhāśca kapilādayaḥ || 1.1 || lakṣmī sarasvatī durgā sāvitrī rādhikā parā | bhaktyā namanti yaṃ śaśvattaṃ namāmi parātparaṃ || 1.2 || dhyāyante satataṃ santo yogino vaiṣṇavāstathā | jyotirabhyantare rūpaṃ atulaṃ śyāmasundaraṃ || 1.3 || dhyāyettaṃ paramaṃ brahma paramātmānaṃ īśvaraṃ | nirīhaṃ atinirliptaṃ nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ paraṃ || 1.4 || sarveśaṃ sarvarūpaṃ ca sarvakāraṇakāraṇaṃ | satyaṃ nityaṃ ca puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ paraṃ avyayaṃ || 1.5 || maṅgalyaṃ maṅgalārhaṃ ca maṅgalaṃ maṅgalālayaṃ | svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ dhāma bhagavantaṃ sanātanaṃ || 1.6 || stuvanti vedā yaṃ śaśvannānantaṃ jānanti yasya te | taṃ stoṃi paramānandaṃ sānandaṃ nandanandanaṃ || 1.7 || bhaktapriyaṃ ca bhakteśaṃ bhaktānugrahavigrahaṃ | śrīdaṃ śrīśaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rādhikeśvaraṃ || 1.8 || jñānāmṛtaṃ jñānasindhoḥ saṃprāpya śaṅkarādguroḥ | parāvarācca paramādyogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguroḥ || 1.9 || vedebhyo dadhisindhubhyaścaturbhyaḥ sumanoharaṃ | tajjñānamanthadaṇḍena saṃnirmathya navaṃ navaṃ || 1.10 || navanītaṃ samuddhṛtya natvā śambhoḥ padāmbujaṃ | vidhiputro nārado'haṃ pañcarātraṃ samārabhe || 1.11 || oṃ nārāyaṇāśrame puṇye puṇyakṣetre ca bhārata | siddhe nārāyaṇakṣetre vaṭamūle supuṇyade || 1.12 || kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktaṃ ca palaṃ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaṃ | śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhojadhyānaikatānamānasaṃ || 1.13 || japantaṃ paramaṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayaṃ | sukhāsane sukhāsīnaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ muniṃ || 1.14 || papraccha śukadevaśca sarvajñaṃ pitaraṃ muniḥ | kāraṇaṇca purāṇānāṃ purāṇaṃ paraṃ avyayaṃ || 1.15 || śrīśuka uvāca bhagavansarvatattvajña vedavedāṅgapāraga | yadyatprakāraṃ jñānaṃ ca nigūḍhaṃ śrutisammataṃ || 1.16 || teṣu yatsārabhūtaṃ cāpyajñānāndhapradīpakaṃ | tattatsarvaṃ samālocya māṃ bodhayituṃ arhasi || 1.17 || atha śrīkṛṣṇabhaktipraśaṃśā sa pitā jñānadātā yo jñānaṃ tatkṛṣṇabhaktidaṃ | sā bhaktiḥ paramā śuddhā kṛṣṇadāsyapradā ca yā || 1.18 || tadeva dāsyaṃ śastaṃ yatsākṣāccaraṇasevanaṃ | nityaṃ golokavāsaṃ ca purataḥ stavanaṃ hareḥ || 1.19 || śaśvannimeṣarahitaṃ tatpādapadmadarśanaṃ | śaśvattatsārdhaṃ ālāpasevākarmaniyojanaṃ || 1.20 || tena sārdhaṃ avicchedasthānaṃ paraṃ śobhanaṃ | bhaktānāṃ vāñcchitaṃ vastu sārabhūtaṃ śrutau śrutaṃ || 1.21 || putrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vyāsadevo jahāsa saḥ | vijñāya jñāninaṃ putraṃ paramāhlādaṃ āpa ha || 1.22 || putraṃ śubhāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā sarvajñaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ | yathāprāptaṃ gurumukhātpravaktuṃ upacakrame || 1.23 || śrīvyāsa uvāca śuka dhanyo'si mānyo'si puṇyarūpo'si bhārate | putreṇa bhavatāsmākaṃ kulaṃ muktaṃ ca pāvanaṃ || 1.24 || sa putraḥ kṛṣṇabhakto yo bhārate suyaśaskaraḥ | punāti puṃsāṃ śatakaṃ janmamātreṇa līlayā || 1.25 || mātāmahānāṃ śatakaṃ mātaraṃ mātṛmātaraṃ | sodarānbāndhavāṃścaiva bhṛtyānpatnīṃ sahātmajāṃ || 1.26 || yatkanyāṃ pratigṛhṇāti tadādipuruṣatrayaṃ | kanyāpradātā śvaśuro jīvanmuktaḥ sabhāryakaḥ || 1.27 || svayaṃ vidhātā bhagavānparaṃ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ | kṛṣṇabhakto vasiṣṭastu tatsuto vaiṣṇavaḥ svayaṃ || 1.28 || vaiṣṇavastatsutaḥ śaktiḥ kṛṣṇadhyānaikamānasaḥ | parāśaraśca tatputraḥ kṛṣṇapādābjasevayā || 1.29 || jīvanmukto mahājñānī yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ | ahaṃ vedavibhaktā ca śrīkṛṣṇapādasevayā || 1.30 || gururme bhagavānsākṣādyogīndro nārado muniḥ | gurorgururme śambhuśca yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ || 1.31 || teṣāṃ puṇyena putrastvaṃ puṇyarāśiśca mūrtimān | padmānāṃ mama puṃsāṃ ca prakāśo bhāskaraḥ svayaṃ || 1.32 || śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhojaṃ pādābjaṃ nāradeśayoḥ | sarasvatīṃ namaskṛtya jñānaṃ vakṣye sanātanaṃ || 1.33 || śrūyatāṃ pañcarātraṃ ca vedasāraṃ abhīpsitaṃ | pañcasaṃvādaṃ iṣṭaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ abhivāñcchitaṃ || 1.34 || prāṇādhikaṃ priyaṃ śuddhaṃ paraṃ jñānāmṛtaṃ śubhaṃ | atha ṣaṭsaṃvādāḥ ?what? hi goloke śataśṛṅge ca parvate || 1.35 || supuṇye virajātīre vaṭamūle manohare | purato rādhikāyāśca brahmāṇaṃ kamalodbhavaṃ || 1.36 || taṃ uvāca mahābhaktaṃ stuvantaṃ praṇataṃ sutaṃ | pañcarātraṃ idaṃ puṇyaṃ śrutvā ca jagatāṃ vidhiḥ || 1.37 || praṇamya rādhikāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prayayau śivamandiraṃ | bhaktyā taṃ pūjayāṃ āsa śaṅkaraḥ paramādaraṃ || 1.38 || sukhāsane sukhāsīnaṃ svasthaṃ bhaktaṃ ca pūjitaṃ | papraccha vārtāṃ vinayī vinayena sukhāvahāṃ || 1.39 || sarvaṃ taṃ kathayāṃ āsa pañcarātrādikaṃ śubhaṃ | vasantaṃ vaṭamūle ca svarge mandākinītaṭe || 1.40 || yogīndrairapi siddhendrairmunīndraiśca stutaṃ prabhuṃ | jñānāmṛtaṃ taṃ uktvā sa brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha || 1.41 || śambhuśca kathayāṃ āsa svaśiṣyaṃ nāradaṃ muniṃ | nāradaḥ kathayāṃ āsa puṣkare sūryaparvaṇi || 1.42 || māṃ bhaktaṃ anuraktaṃ ca puṇyāhe munisaṃsadi | pañcarātraṃ idaṃ śuddhaṃ bhramāndhadhvaṃsadīpakaṃ || 1.43 || atha pañcarātrapadavyākhyā rātraṃ ca jñānavacanaṃ jñānaṃ pañcavidhaṃ smṛtaṃ | tenedaṃ pañcarātraṃ ca pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || 1.44 || jñānaṃ paramatattvaṃ ca janmamṛtyujarāpahaṃ | tato mṛtyuñjayaḥ śambhuḥ saṃprāpa kṛṣṇavaktrataḥ || 1.45 || jñānaṃ dvitīyaṃ paramaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ ca vāñcchitaṃ | paraṃ muktipradaṃ śuddhaṃ yato līnaṃ hareḥ pade || 1.46 || jñānaṃ śuddhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca maṅgalaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktidaṃ | taddāsyaṃ adhīṣṭaṃ ca yato dāsyaṃ labheddhareḥ || 1.47 || caturthaṃ yaugikaṃ jñānaṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ paraṃ | sarvasvaṃ yogināṃ putra siddhānāṃ ca sukhapradaṃ || 1.48 || aṇimā laghimā vyāptiḥ prākāmyaṃ mahimā tathā | īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca tathākāmāvasāyitā || 1.49 || sāvajñaṃ dūraśravaṇaṃ parakāyapraveśanaṃ | kāyavyūhaṃ jīvadānaṃ parajīvaharaṃ paraṃ || 1.50 || sargakartṛtvaśilpaṃ ca sargasaṃhārakāraṇaṃ | siddhaṃ ca ṣoḍaśavidhaṃ jñānināṃ ca yato bhaveth || 1.51 || jñānaṃ ca paramaṃ proktaṃ tadvai vaiṣayikaṃ nṛṇāṃ | yadiṣṭadevī māyā sā paraṃ saṃmohakāraṇaṃ || 1.52 || viṣaye baddhacitaṃ ca sarvaṃ indriyasevanaṃ | poṣanaṃ svakuṭumbānāṃ svātmanaśca niranrataṃ || 1.53 || prathamaṃ sāttvikaṃ jñānaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca tadeva ca | nairguṇyaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca jñānaṃ ca sarvataḥ paraṃ || 1.54 || caturthaṃ ca rājasikaṃ bhaktastannābhivāñcchati | pañcamaṃ tāmasaṃ jñānaṃ vidvāṃstannābhivāñcchati || 1.55 || jñānaṃ pañcavidhaṃ proktaṃ pañcarātraṃ vidurbudhāḥ | pañcarātraṃ saptavidhaṃ jñānināṃ jñānadaṃ paraṃ || 1.56 || brāhmaṃ śaivaṃ ca koṃāraṃ vāsiṣṭaṃ kāpilaṃ paraṃ | gautamīyaṃ nāradīyaṃ idaṃ saptavidhaṃ smṛtaṃ || 1.57 || atha granthapraśaṃsā ṣaṭpañcarātraṃ vedāśca purāṇāni ca sarvaśaḥ | itihāsaṃ dharmaśāstraṃ śātraṃ ca siddhiyogajaṃ || 1.58 || dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ samālokya jñānaṃ saṃprāpya śaṅkarāth | jñānāmṛtaṃ pañcarātraṃ cakāra nārado muniḥ || 1.59 || puṇyaṃ ca pāpavighnaṃ bhaktidāsyapradaṃ hareḥ | sarvasvaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca priyaṃ prāṇādhikaṃ suta || 1.60 || sārabhūtaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vedānāṃ paramādbhutaṃ | nāradīyaṃ pañcarātraṃ purāṇeṣu sudurlabhaṃ || 1.61 || sarvāntarātmā bhagavānbrahmajyotiḥ sanātanaṃ | paripūrṇatamaḥ śrīmānyathā kṛṣṇaḥ sureṣu ca || 1.62 || yathā devīṣu pūjyā sā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī | vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca siddhānāṃ jñānināṃ yogināṃ śivaḥ || 1.63 || viśvastānāṃ indriyānāṃ manaśca śīghragāmināṃ | brahmā ca vedaviduṣāṃ pūjyānāṃ ca gaṇeśvaraḥ || 1.64 || sanatkumāro bhagavānmunīnāṃ pravaro yathā | bṛhaspatirbuddhimatāṃ siddhānāṃ kapilo yathā || 1.65 || yogīndrānāṃ satāṃ śuddha ṛṣirnārāyaṇo yathā | kavīnāṃ ca yathā śukraḥ paṇḍitānāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ || 1.66 || saritāṃ ca yathā gaṅgā samudrāṇāṃ jalārṇavaḥ | vṛndāvanaṃ vanānāṃ ca varṣānāṃ bhārataṃ yathā || 1.67 || puṣkaraṃ tatra tīrthānāṃ pūjyānāṃ vaiṣṇavo yathā | ātmākāśo yathāptānāṃ yathā kāśī purīṣu ca || 1.68 || vṛkṣāṇāṃ kalpavṛkṣaśca surabhī kāmadhenuṣu | puṣpāṇāṃ pārijātaśca patrāṇāṃ tulasī yathā || 1.69 || mantrāṇāṃ kṛṣṇamantraśca yathā vidyā dhaneṣvapi | yathā tejasvināṃ sūryo miṣṭānāṃ amṛtaṃ yathā || 1.70 || ādhārāṇāṃ ca sthūlānāṃ mahāviṣṇuryathā suta | sūkṣmāṇāṃ paramāṇuśca guruṇāṃ mantratantradaḥ || 1.71 || putraśca snehapātrāṇāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathā śaśī | yathā ghṛtaṃ ca gavyānāṃ śasyānāṃ dhānyaṃ īpsitaṃ || 1.72 || śāstrāṇāṃ ca yathā vedāḥ sāśramāṇāṃ yathā dvijaḥ | taijasānāṃ yathā ratnaṃ muktāmāṇikyahīrakaṃ || 1.73 || yathā chandasi gāyatrī durgā śaktimatīṣvapi | pativratāsu laksmīśca kṣamāśīlāsu medinī || 1.74 || saubhāgyāsu sundarīṣu rādhā kṛṣṇapriyāsu ca | hanumānvānarāṇāṃ ca pakṣiṇāṃ garuḍo yathā || 1.75 || vāhanānāṃ balavatāṃ śaṅkarasya yathā vṛṣaḥ | śālagrāmaśca yantrāṇāṃ pūjāsu kṛṣṇapūjanaṃ || 1.76 || ekādaśī vratānāṃ ca tapaḥsvanaśanaṃ yathā | yajñānāṃ japayajñaśca satyaṃ dharmeṣu putraka || 1.77 || suśīlaṃ ca guṇānāṃ ca puṇyeṣu kṛṣṇakīrtanaṃ | śobhāśu sukhadṛśyeṣu prabhā tejaḥsu sarvataḥ || 1.78 || poṣṭrīṇāṃ upakartṛṇāṃ mitrāṇāṃ jananī yathā | lokānāṃ api lokeśaḥ śeṣo nāgeṣu pūjitaḥ || 1.79 || sudarśanaṃ ca śastrāṇāṃ viśvakarmā ca śilpināṃ | dharmiṣṭheṣu dayāvatsu devarṣisu mahatsu ca || 1.80 || viṣṇubhakteṣu vijñeṣu yathaiva nārado muniḥ | evaṃ ca sarvaśāstreṣu pañcarātraṃ ca pūjitaṃ || 1.81 || yathā nipīya pīyūṣaṃ na spṛhā cānyavastuṣu | pañcarātraṃ abhijñāya nānyeṣu ca spṛhā satāṃ || 1.82 || sarvārthajñānabījaṃ cāpyajñānāndhapradīpaṃ | vedasāroddhṛtaṃ tattvaṃ sarveṣāṃ samabhīpsitaṃ || 1.83 || iti śrīnāradapañcarātre granthapraśaṃsanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ <2> prathamaikarātre dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ śuka uvāca kutra vā pañcarātraṃ ca nāradasya ca dhīmate | pradattaṃ śambhunā tāta tanme vyākhyātuṃ arhasi || 2.1 || atha nāradasya tapovarṇanam vyāsa uvāca adhītya sarvānvedāṃśca vedāṅgāṇpiturantike | jagāma tītrhaṃ kedāraṃ supraśastaṃ ca bhārate || 2.2 || himālayasya pūrve ya gaṅgātīre manohare | siddhe nārāyaṇakṣetre sarveṣāṃ abhivāñcchite || 2.3 || tapaścakāra sa munirdivyaṃ varṣasahasrakaṃ | pitroktenaiva vidhinā satataṃ saṃyutaḥ śuciḥ || 2.4 || śuśrāvākāśavāṇīṃ ca tapaso'nte mahāmuniḥ | svalpākṣarāṃ ca bahvarthāṃ pariṇāmasukhāvahāṃ || 2.5 || atha nāradaṃ prati daivavāṇī aśarīriṣyuvāca ādhārito yadi haristapasā tataḥ kiṃ | nādhārito yadi haristapasā tataḥ kiṃ | antarbahiryadi haristapasā tataḥ kiṃ | nāntarbahiryadi haristapasā tataḥ kiṃ || 2.6 || virama virama brahmankiṃ tapasyāsu vatsa | vraja vraja dvija śīghraṃ śaṅkaraṃ jñānasindhuṃ | labha labha haribhaktiṃ vaiṣṇavoktāṃ supakvāṃ | bhavanigaḍanibandhachedinīṃ kartanīṃ ca || 2.7 || iti śrutvā ca sa munirvimanāḥ svarṇadītaṭe | cakārārthānusandhānaṃ na prasannaṃ ca tanmanaḥ || 2.8 || ruroda svarṇadītīre smāraṃ smāraṃ hareḥ padaṃ | dadarśa puratastātaṃ brahmāṇaṃ sakumārakaṃ || 2.9 || nanāma sahasā mūrdhnā pitaraṃ taṃ sahodaraṃ | pādyaṃ arghyaṃ ca pradadau javena sādaraṃ muniḥ || 2.10 || ślokadvayārthaṃ papraccha kumāraṃ jagatāṃ vidhiṃ | sukhāsīnaṃ susthiraṃ ca sasmitaṃ ca gataśramaṃ || 2.11 || svātmārāmaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ jñānināṃ ca gurorguruṃ | sāśrunetraḥ pulakito bhaktyā praṇatakandharaṃ || 2.12 || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā taṃ kātaraṃ vidhiḥ | putreṇa sārddhaṃ ālocya vyākhyāṃ kartuṃ samārebhe || 2.13 || atha daivavāṇyarthaḥ brahmovāca he vatsa pūrvaślokārthaṃ nigūḍhaṃ śrutisammataṃ | vedārthaṃ dvividhaṃ śuddhaṃ vyākhyāṃ kurvanti vaidikāḥ || 2.14 || ārādhito yadi hariryena puṃsā svabhaktitaḥ | kiṃ tasya tapasā vyarthaṃ tīrthapūtasya nārada || 2.15 || kṛṣṇamantropāsakasya jīvanmuktasya bhārate | tapaścopahāsabījaṃ tathā carvitacarvaṇaṃ || 2.16 || mantragrahaṇamātreṇa puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ suta | punāti svasvabhaktaṃ ca cāndhavaṃścāvalīlayā || 2.17 || nahi dharmo nahi tapaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasevanātparaṃ | pariśramaṃ ca viphalaṃ tapasā vaiṣṇavasya ca || 2.18 || kṛṣṇamantropāsakasya tīrthapūtasya putraka | tīrthasnānaṃ anaśanaṃ vedeṣu ca viḍambanaṃ || 2.19 || pūrvakarmānurodhena yatpāpaṃ vaiṣṇavasya ca | mantragrahaṇamātreṇa naṣṭaṃ vahnau yathā tṛṇaṃ || 2.20 || pavitraḥ paramo vahniḥ pavitraṃ cāmalaṃ jalaṃ | pavitraṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ tīrthaṃ yattulasīdalaṃ || 2.21 || punāti līlayaitāni śuddhaḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ | upasparśa ca bhaktasyāpyete vāñcchanti sādaraṃ || 2.22 || bhaktasya pādarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā | nahi pūtastribhuvane śrīkṛṣṇasevakātparaḥ || 2.23 || śāligrāmaśilācakre karoti kṛṣṇapūjanaṃ | tatpādodakanaivedyaṃ nityaṃ bhuṅkte ca yaḥ pumān || 2.24 || sa vaiṣṇavo mahāpūtastanmantropāsakaḥ śuciḥ | punāti puṃsāṃ śatakaṃ janmamātrātsabāndhavaṃ || 2.25 || vatsa ślokasyaikapādaṃ vyākhyātaṃ ca yathāgamaṃ | vyākhyātaṃ karomyanyapādaṃ yathājñānaṃ miśāmaya || 2.26 || nārādhito yadi hariryena puṃsādhamena ca | kiṃ tasya tapasā vyarthaṃ niṣphalaṃ tatpariśramaḥ || 2.27 || vratānyeva hi dānāni tapāṃsyanaśanāni ca | vedopayuktā yajñāśca karmāṇi ca śubhāni ca | na niṣpunātyabhaktaṃ ca surākumbhaṃ ivāpagā || 2.28 || abhaktasparśamātreṇa tīrthāni kampitāni ca | abhaktabhāraduḥkhena kampitā sā vasundharā || 2.29 || ślokārdhaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa kiṃcideva yathāgamaṃ | tasyārdhasyāpi vyākhyānaṃ karomīti niśāmaya || 2.30 || vedasāraṃ kṛṣṇamataṃ mamāpi nahi kalpanā | antarbahiryadi hairyeṣāṃ puṃsāṃ mahātmanāṃ || 2.31 || svapne jāgaraṇe śaśvattapasteṣāṃ ca niṣphalaṃ | sa eva viṣṇutulyo hi tadaṃśo bhārate mune || 2.32 || tasya rakṣānibandhena tadabhyāse sudarśanaṃ | dhyānamātreṇa niṣpāpaḥ punāti bhuvanatrayaṃ || 2.33 || datvā cakraṃ ca rakṣārthaṃ na niścinto janārdanaḥ | svayaṃ tannikaṭaṃ yāti draṣṭuṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || 2.34 || tatparo hi priyo nāsti kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ | nahi bhaktātparaścātmā prāṇāścāvayavādayaḥ | na lakṣmī rādhikā vāṇī svayaṃbhuḥ śambhureva ca || 2.35 || bhaktaprāṇo hi kṛṣṇaśca kṛṣṇaprāṇā hi vaiṣṇavāḥ | dhyāyante vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇaśca vaiṣṇavāṃstathā || 2.36 || vyākhyātaṃ ca tripādaṃ ca he munīndra yathāgamaṃ | śeṣapādasya vyākhyānaṃ karomīti niśāmaya || 2.37 || nāntarbahiryadi hariryeṣāṃ puṃsāṃ ca nārada | teṣāṃ api tapo vyarthaṃ antarmalinacetasāṃ || 2.38 || kiṃ tajjñānena tapasā vratena niyamena ca | tīrthasnānena puṇyenāpi abhaktamūḍhacetasāṃ || 2.39 || kṛṣṇabhaktivihīnebhyo dvijebhyaḥ śvapaco mahān | śūkaro mlecchanivahaḥ svadharmācareṇa ca || 2.40 || svadharmahīnā viprāścāpyabhakṣyabhakṣaṇena ca | nityaṃ nityaṃ vidharmeṇa patitāḥ śvapacādhamāḥ || 2.41 || brahmaṇānāṃ svadharmaśca santataṃ kṛṣṇasevanaṃ | nityaṃ te bhuñjate santastannaivedyaṃ pādodakaṃ || 2.42 || na datvā haraye yastu yadi bhuṅkte dvijādhamaḥ | annaṃ viṣṭhāsamaṃ mūtrasamaṃ toyaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 2.43 || bhuṅkte svabhakṣyaṃ kolaśca mlecchaśca śvapacādhamaḥ | vipro nityaṃ abhakṣyaṃ ca bhuṅkte ca patitastataḥ || 2.44 || ślokaṃ ekaṃ ca vyākhyātaṃ yathājñānaṃ ca nārada | sannibodha parasyārdhaṃ vyākhyānaṃ ca yathocitaṃ || 2.45 || tapaso virama brahmanvyarthaṃ bhaktatapo dhruvaṃ | śaṅkaraśca guruṃ kṛtvā haribhaktiṃ labhāciraṃ || 2.46 || supakvā haribhaktiśca taraṇī bhavatāraṇe | gurureva paraṃ brahma karṇadhārasvarūpakaḥ || 2.47 || ityevaṃ uktvā tvāṃ devī prajagāma sarasvatī | vyākhyātastadabhiprāyaḥ kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi te || 2.48 || brahmāṇaśca vacaḥ śrutvā jahāsa yogināṃ guruḥ | sanatkumāro bhagavānuvāca pitaraṃ śuka || 2.49 || sanatkumāra uvāca pūrvaślokasya vyākhyānaṃ na buddhaṃ śiśunā mayā | putraṃ śiṣyaṃ abodhaṃ ca yuktaṃ bodhayituṃ punaḥ || 2.50 || ārādhito hariryena tasya vyarthaṃ tapo yadi | nārādhito hairyena tasya vyartaṃ tapo yadi || 2.51 || tasyārahitau tau dvau tapasaśca sthalaṃ kutaḥ | tapaḥ kurvanti ye tāta tvaṃ māṃ bodhaya bālakaṃ || 2.52 || putrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā sandigdho jagatāṃ guruḥ | dadhyau kṛṣṇapadāmbhojaṃ paraṃ kalpataruṃ śuka || 2.53 || kṣaṇaṃ saṃcitya pādābjaṃ prāpa rāddhāntaṃ īpsitaṃ | vyākhyāṃ kartuṃ samārebhe vidhātā jagatāṃ api || 2.54 || atha naivedyapraśaṃsā brahmovāca dhanyo'haṃ bhavataḥ putrātjñānināṃ ca gurorguroḥ | viṣṇubhaktācca dharmiṣṭhātsatputrācca pitā sukhī || 2.55 || dhanyo'si paṇḍito'si tvaṃ haribhakto'si putraka | mamāpi saphalaṃ janma jīvanaṃ ca tvayā budha || 2.56 || nibodha pūrvaślokārthaṃ punarvyākhyāṃ karomi ca | tathāpi cenna santoṣo bhavānvyākhyāṃ kariṣyati || 2.57 || āśabdaḥ samyagarthe ca rādhitaḥ prāptavācakaḥ | saṃprāptaśca hariryena vyarthastasya tapaḥśramaḥ || 2.58 || yena samyakprakāreṇa saṃprāpto harirīśvaraḥ | svapne jñāne ca jñātasteṣāṃ vyarthastapaḥśramaḥ || 2.59 || śrīkṛṣṇavimukhaṃ mūḍhaṃ dvijaṃ eva narādhamaṃ | tīrthaṃ dānaṃ tāpaḥ puṇyaṃ vrataṃ naiva punāti taṃ || 2.60 || yaśca mūḍhatamo loke yaśca bhaktiṃ parāṃ gataḥ | tāvubhau sukhasedhete tapaḥ kurvanti madhyamāḥ || 2.61 || devānanyāṃśca bhajate hariṃ jānāti tatparaḥ | tapaḥ karoti taṃ prāptuṃ ākāṅkṣanmadhyamo janaḥ || 2.62 || prāktanādanurāgī ca gṛhī saṃsārasaṃvṛtaḥ | tapaḥ karoti śrīkṛṣṇapādapadmārthaṃ īpsitaṃ || 2.63 || paraṃ śrīkṛṣṇabhajanaṃ dhyānaṃ tannāmakīrtanaṃ | tatpādodakanaivedyabhakṣaṇaṃ sarvavāñcchitaṃ || 2.64 || atīva mūḍho vipraśca prāktanādgurudoṣataḥ | tāmaso hi na jānāti śrīkṛṣṇaṃ triguṇātparaṃ || 2.65 || ajñānādatha vā jñānātsatsaṅgādeva prāktanāth | bhuṅkte naivedyaṃ īśasya kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ || 2.66 || sa ca mukto bhavetputra mucyate sarvapātakāth | sa yāti divyayānena golokaṃ lokaṃ uttamaṃ || 2.67 || śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi pūrvākhyānaṃ purātanaṃ | atīva suśravaṃ cāru madhuraṃ muktidaṃ paraṃ || 2.68 || kānyakubjaḥ sukṣubdhaśca brāhmaṇo grāmayājakaḥ | devalo vṛṣavāhaśca mahāmūḍhaśca pātakī || 2.69 || svapne jñāne na jānāti puṇyaṃ vā kṛṣṇapūjanaṃ | kṛṣṇabhaktasahālāpadarśanasparśanaṃ śubhaṃ || 2.70 || babhūva prāktanāttasya kṣaṇamātraṃ sudurlabhaṃ | tena puṇyena naivedyaṃ lebhe kṛṣṇasya brāhmaṇaḥ || 2.71 || pituḥ puṇyena putraśca mārge patitaṃ alpakaṃ | svayaṃ bhuktāvaśeṣaṃ ca patitaṃ vaiṣṇavājjanāth || 2.72 || susnigdhākṣatajīrṇaṃ ca rajasā miśritaṃ paraṃ | gacchatastatra viprasya patitaṃ bhakṣyavastu ca || 2.73 || naivedyopari kṛṣṇasya tvarāyuktasya putraka | tadvastu bhuktaṃ vipreṇa kṛṣṇanaivedyamiśritaṃ || 2.74 || saputreṇa kṣudhārtena tau yayaturgṛhaṃ | viprocchiṣṭaṃ ca bubhuje tasya patnī pativratā || 2.75 || paramparānusaṃbandhātpavitrā sā babhūva ha | jīvanmukto brāhmaṇaśca babhūva sa saputrakaḥ || 2.76 || kālena tena puṇyena vyāghrabhuktaśca kānane | sārdhaṃ ca vyāghraputrābhyāṃ golokaṃ prayayau dvija | pativratā sahamṛtā bhartā sārdhaṃ jagāma sā || 2.77 || iti śrīnāradapañcarātre jñānāmṛtasāre prathamaikarātre brahmasanatkumārasaṃvāde naivedyapraśaṃsanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ <3> prathamaikarātre tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ sanatkumāra uvāca aho tāta kiṃ āścaryaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ | paraṃ naivedyamāhātmyaṃ vistarādvada sāmprataṃ || 3.1 || atha śrīkṛṣṇamahimavarṇanam brahmovāca ekadā brāhmaṇo hṛṣṭaḥ praphullavadanekṣaṇaḥ | putreṇa sārdhaṃ prayayau bāndhavasya gṛhaṃ mudā || 3.2 || nimantrito vivāhena mahāsaṃbhārasaṃbhṛtaḥ | bhuktvā pītvā ca tadgṛhe svagṛhaṃ prayayau mudā || 3.3 || saputro brāhmaṇo mārge kṣutpipāsārditaḥ sutaḥ | dadarśa candrabhāgāṃ tāṃ nadīṃ atimanoharāṃ || 3.4 || uvāca putraḥ pitraṃ snātvā bhokṣyāmi ceti bhoḥ | kṣutpipāsā balavatī vardhate tāta vartmani || 3.5 || putrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā taṃ uvāca dvijaḥ svayaṃ | bhayaṃkaraṃ vanaṃ idaṃ samīpe saritaḥ sutaḥ || 3.6 || suśīghraṃ gaccha grāmāntaṃ puro ramyasarovaraṃ | tatra snātvā ca bhokṣyāvo gaccha vatsa yathāsukhaṃ || 3.7 || tātasya vacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa ca cukopa ha | pitaraṃ vaktuṃ ārebhe raktapaṇgkajalocanaḥ || 3.8 || śiśuruvāca bālo'haṃ daśavarṣīyastvaṃ ca vṛddhaśca jñānadaḥ | pitā dadāti putrāya jñānaṃ sarvatra bhūtale || 3.9 || aho duratyayaḥ kālo vṛdhho vadati bālavath | kathaṃ prāktanaṃ ullaṅghya brūhi tāta duratyayaṃ || 3.10 || prāktanātsukhaduḥkhaṃ ca rogaṃ śokaṃ bhayaṃ pitaḥ | sumṛtyurapamṛtyurvā cirāyuralpajīvanaḥ || 3.11 || yatra kāle ca yanmṛtyurbhavanaṃ śubhakarma ca | nyūnādhikaṃ kṣaṇaṃ nāsti niṣekaḥ kena vāryate || 3.12 || yasya haste ca yanmṛtyurvidhātrā likhitaḥ purā | na ca taṃ khaṇḍituṃ śaktaḥ svayaṃ viṣṇuśca śaṅkaraḥ || 3.13 || tāta vyarthaṃ adhītaṃ te durbuddherjanma niṣphalaṃ | subuddheḥ saphalaṃ janma tatkṣaṇaṃ jīvanaṃ sukhaṃ || 3.14 || yena śuklīkṛtā haṃsāḥ śukāśca haritīkṛtāḥ | mayūrāścitritā yena sa me rakṣāṃ kariṣyati || 3.15 || yena kṛṣṇena viśvāni cāsaṃkhyāni kṛtāni ca | carācaraṃ ca yo rakṣetsa me rakṣāṃ kariṣyati || 3.16 || ghorāraṇye sukhaṃ śete yo hi kṛṣṇena rakṣitaḥ | nirbandho'pi yasya maraṇaṃ tasya mandire || 3.17 || yaḥ śete nāgaśayyāsu prāktanānmaṅgalāhitaḥ | yo nāgabhakṣito bhogātsa bhṛto garuḍāntike || 3.18 || na samudre ca mriyate nāgnirāśau viṣānale | na śastreṇa na cāstreṇāyurmarmāṇi rakṣati || 3.19 || nāprāptakālo mriyate viddhaḥ śaraśatairapi | tṛṇāgreṇāpi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ prāptakālo na jīvati || 3.20 || kaścidgarbhe ca mriyate kaścidbhūmiṣṭamātrataḥ | kaścidyauvanakāle ca kaścideva hi vārddhake || 3.21 || kaścidcirāyu rogī cāpyarogī cāpi kaścana | kaściddhanī daridraśca kaścideva hi karmaṇā || 3.22 || kaścitkalpāntajīvī ca cirajīvī ca kaścana | prāktanādamaraḥ kaścinniṣeko balavattaraḥ || 3.23 || kaścidyāti ca rājendro divyayānena karmaṇā | kaścitkīṭapataṅgeṣu kaścitpaśvādiyoniṣu || 3.24 || kaścideva hi sannyāsī kaścicca naraghātakaḥ | kaścidgajendragāmī ca paśuyāyī ca kaścana || 3.25 || kaścidsūkṣmāṃśukādhārī kaścijjīrṇapaṭī janaḥ || 3.26 || kaścinnagno'apyanāhārī sudhābhojī ca ca kaścana | kaścicca sundaraḥ śrīmāngalatkuṣṭī ca kaścana || 3.27 || kaścitkubjaścāṅgahīno badhiraḥ kāṇa eva ca | kaściddīrgho madhyamaśca kaścitkhañjaśca vāmanaḥ || 3.28 || kaścitkṛṣṇaśca gauraśca śyāmalaśca svakarmaṇā | kaścidbhaktyā ca prāpnoti kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ sudurlabhaṃ || 3.29 || brahmaṇaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ janmamṛtyujarāharaṃ | kaścitprāpnoti paramaṃ brahmalokaṃ nirāmayaṃ || 3.30 || kaścitsvargaṃ indrapadaṃ śivalokaṃ svakarmaṇā | kaścitvargaṃ indralokaṃ yamalokaṃ ca kaścana || 3.31 || kaścicca narake ghore prāpnoti kleśaṃ ulvaṇaṃ | tādito yamadūtena kṣudhitastṛṣitaḥ sadā || 3.32 || bhuṅkte viṇmūtrakīṭaṃ tanmalaṃ śleṣmaṃ garaṃ vasāṃ | kṣuradhāre taptataile vahnau śite jale sthale || 3.33 || prāpnoti dāruṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ ākalpaṃ pātakī pitaḥ | tathā bhogāvaśeṣe ca labdhā janma svakarmaṇā || 3.34 || vyādhiyuktaḥ pramucyeta tayā cedīśvarecchayā | yadbhayādvāti vāto'yaṃ sūryastapati yadbhayāth || 3.35 || varṣatīndro dahatyagnirmṛtyuścarati jantuṣu | yasyājñayā sṛṣṭividhau mūrmo'nantaṃ dadhāti ca || 3.36 || sa ca sarvaṃ ca brahmāṇḍaṃ līlayā ceśvarecchayā | yasyājñayā mahābhītā sarvādhārā vasundharā || 3.37 || dharā sā sarvasyādyā ratnavāṃśca himālayaḥ | svayaṃ vidhātā bhagavāndhyāyate yaṃ aharniśaṃ || 3.38 || yaṃ dhyāyate ca bhajate svayaṃ mṛtuñjayaḥ śivaḥ | sahasravaktro'yaṃ stauti dhyāyate bhajate sadā || 3.39 || svayaṃ sarasvatī stauti yaṃ īśvaraṃ abhīpsitaṃ | sevate pādapadmaṃ ca svayaṃ padmālayā pitaḥ || 3.40 || māyā bhītā ca yaṃ stauti durgā durgatināśinī | stuvanti vedāḥ satataṃ sāvitrī vedamātṛkā || 3.41 || siddhendrāśca munīndrāśca yogīndrāḥ sanakādayaḥ | rājendrāścāsurendrāśca surendrā manavastathā || 3.42 || dhyāyante ca bhajante ca bhaktāḥ santo hi santataṃ | kecidvidanti yaṃ brahmāṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanaṃ || 3.43 || kecitpradhānaṃ sarvādyaṃ kecicca jyotirīśvaraṃ | kecicca sarvarūpaṃ ca sarvakāraṇakāraṇaṃ || 3.44 || kecitsvecchābhayaṃ rūpaṃ bhaktānugrahavigrahaṃ | kecitsuruciraṃ śyāmasundaraṃ manoharaṃ || 3.45 || sānandaṃ paramānandaṃ govindaṃ nandanandanaṃ | bhaja tāta paraṃ brahma smara śaśvatsureśvaraṃ || 3.46 || ityevaṃ uktvā pitaraṃ candrabhāgānadījale | snātvā papau jalaṃ svacchaṃ bubhuje miṣṭamodakaṃ || 3.47 || pitā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sānandāśru mumoca saḥ | cucumba gaṇḍaṃ putrasya samāśleṣaṇapūrvakaṃ || 3.48 || pitā snātvā samārebhe sandhyāṃ kartuṃ ca pūjanaṃ | susnātaṃ pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā putraḥ sa prayayau vanaṃ || 3.49 || patraṃ bhojanapātrārthaṃ arhatuṃ cañcalaḥ śiśuḥ | cakāra cayanaṃ tūrṇaṃ praśastaṃ patrapañcakaṃ || 3.50 || sundaraṃ kusumaṃ vanyaṃ pūjanārthaṃ pitustathā | dadarśa purato bālaḥ supakvaṃ vadarīphalaṃ || 3.51 || cakāra cayanaṃ tāni phalāni śobhanāni ca | dhātrīphalaṃ supakvaṃ ca pakvaṃ āmrātakaṃ tathā || 3.52 || supakvaṃ ca kadambaṃ ca cakāra cayanaṃ punaḥ | supakvaṃ sundaraṃ ramyaṃ dāḍimaṃ śrīphalaṃ tathā || 3.53 || ramyaṃ jambuphalaṃ caiva kharjūraṃ sumanoharaṃ | karañjakaṃ ca jāmbīraṃ sundaraṃ cikuraṃ tathā || 3.54 || tatsarvaṃ cayanaṃ kṛtvā dadarśa purataḥ saraḥ | sunirmalaṃ jalaṃ svacchaṃ śvetapadmaṃ manoharaṃ || 3.55 || ruciraṃ raktakahlāraṃ prasphuṭaṃ ca jalāntike | vihāya tāni sarvāṇi saraḥśirasi susthale || 3.56 || papau saraḥsvacchatoyaṃ jahāra padmaṃ ulvaṇaṃ | kiṃcitsuraktakahlāraṃ pakvaṃ padmaphalaṃ tathā || 3.57 || sarvaṃ āharaṇaṃ kṛtvā pitaraṃ gantuṃ udyataḥ | praphullavadanaḥ śrīmānsasmito dvijabālakaḥ || 3.58 || praphullacampakataruṃ dadarśa purataḥ śiśuḥ | mallikāmālatīkundayūthikāmādhavīlatāḥ || 3.59 || cakāra cayanaṃ sphītaḥ puṣpāṇi sundarāṇi ca | puṣpeṇa phalapatreṇa tasya bhāro babhūva ha || 3.60 || bālo voḍhuṃ aśakyantaśca yayau gamanamantharaḥ | na phalaṃ bubhuje so'pi dharmādharmabhayena ca || 3.61 || puro dadarśa sa śiśurghoraṃ vyāghrālayaṃ bhiyā | tāta tāteti śabdaṃ ca cakāra ha punaḥ punaḥ || 3.62 || na dadarśa ca tātaṃ ca śārdulaṃ ca dadarśa saḥ | bhiyā sasmāra govindapādāravaindaṃ īpsitaṃ || 3.63 || hariṃ narahariṃ rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca mādhvaṃ | dāmodaraṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ mukundaṃ madhusūdanaṃ || 3.64 || etāni daśa nāmāni japanvipraśiśurbhiyā | prayayau purataḥ śīghraṃ punareva sarovaraṃ || 3.65 || saraso nirmale tīre puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca | dadau bhaktyā bhagavate kṛṣṇāya paramātmane || 3.66 || śrīkṛṣṇapūjāṃ kurvantaṃ dhyānamānāṃ padāmbujaṃ | nikaṭaṃ na yayau vyāghro dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ ca dūrataḥ || 3.67 || vyāghraṃ dadarśa bālaśca prakaṭāsyaṃ bhayānakaṃ | vikṛtākāradaśanaṃ vikaṭākṣaṃ mahodaraṃ || 3.68 || dṛṣṭvā ca durato vyāghraṃ uvāsa sarasastaṭe | dadhyau kṛṣṇapadāmbhojaṃ janmamṛtyujarāharaṃ || 3.69 || mūlādhāraṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ maṇipūraṃ anāhataṃ | viśuddhaṃ ca tathājñākhyaṃ ṣaṭcakraṃ ca vibhāvya ca || 3.70 || kuṇḍalinyā svaśaktyā ca sahitaṃ parameśvaraṃ | sahasradalapadmasthaṃ hṛdaye svātmanaḥ prabhuṃ || 3.71 || dadarśa dvibhujaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasaṃ | sasmitaṃ sundaraṃ śuddhaṃ navīnajaladaprabhaṃ || 3.72 || koṭikandarpasaundaryalīlādhāmamanoharaṃ | koṭipārvaṇapūrṇenduprabhājuṣṭaṃ ca sundaraṃ || 3.73 || sukhadṛśyaṃ surūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahakārakaṃ | candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaṃ || 3.74 || praphullapadmanayanaṃ rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitaṃ | mālatīmālyasambaddhacūḍācārusuśobhanaṃ || 3.75 || dhṛtaratnaṃ ratnapadmaṃ dakṣiṇena kareṇa ca | vāmena maṇinirmāṇadīptadarpaṇaṃ ujjvalaṃ || 3.76 || ratnakuṇḍālayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitaṃ | kausthubhena maṇīndreṇa cāruvakṣaḥsthalojjvalaṃ || 3.77 | muktārājivinindaikadantarājivirājitaṃ | ājānumālatīmālāvanamālāvibhūṣitaṃ || 3.78 || vedānanasarasvatyā stutaṃ brahmeśavanditaṃ | padmāpadmālayāmāyāsaṃsevitapadāmbujaṃ || 3.79 || paripūrṇatamaṃ brahma paramātmānaṃ īśvaraṃ | nirliptaṃ sākṣibhūtaṃ ca bhagavantaṃ sanātanaṃ || 3.80 || sarveśāṃ sarvarūpaṃ ca sarvakāraṇakāraṇaṃ | puruṣaṃ paramātmaikaṃ pareśaṃ prakṛteḥ paraṃ || 3.81 || evaṃ bhūtaṃ vibhuṃ dṛṣṭvā manasā praṇanāma taṃ | tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā taṃ īśaṃ sampuṭāñjaliḥ || 3.82 || śrīsubhadra uvāca he nātha darśnaṃ dehi māṃ bhaktaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ | śrīda śrīśa śrīnivāsa śrīnidhe śrīniketana || 3.83 || śriyā sevitapādābja śrīsamutpattikāraṇa | vedānirvacaniyeśa nirīha nirguṇādhipa || 3.84 || sarvādya sarvanilaya sarvabīja sanātana | śānta sarasvatīkānta nitānta sarvakarmasu || 3.85 || sarvādhāra nirādhāra kāmapūra parātpara | duṣpārāsārasaṃsārakarṇadhāra namo'stu te || 3.86 || ityevaṃ uktvā sa śiśu ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ | dhyāyena tatpadāmbhojaṃ śaraṇaṃ ca cakāra saḥ || 3.87 || iti viprakṛtaṃ stotraṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 3.88 || iti śrīnāradapañcarātre jñānāmṛtasāre prathamaikarātre brahmasanatkumārasaṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇamahimopālambhanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ <4> prathamaikarātre caturtho'dhyāyaḥ brahmovāca brāhmaṇasya stavaṃ śrutvā parituṣṭo janārdanaḥ | kṛpāṃ cakāra bhagavānbhakteśo bhaktavatsalaḥ || 4.1 || etasminnantare tatra bhagavānnandanandanaḥ | nārāyaṇarṣiḥ kṛpayā cājagāma sarovaraṃ || 4.2 || dadarśa brāhmaṇavaṭuṃ taṃ eva munipuṅgavaṃ | tejasā sukhadṛśyena sundaraṃ sumanoharaṃ || 4.3 || pītavastraparīdhānaṃ navīnajaladaprabhaṃ | candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitaṃ || 4.4 || prasannavadanaṃ śuddhaṃ sasmitaṃ sarvapūjitaṃ | vibhāntaṃ ca japantaṃ śuddhasphaṭikamālayā || 4.5 || dṛṣṭvā nanāma sahasā śirasā viprapuṅgavaḥ | śubhāśiṣaṃ dadau tasmai datvā śirasi hastakaṃ || 4.6 || taṃ uvāca muniśreṣṭhaḥ kṛpayā dīnavatsalaḥ | hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītisāraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvahaṃ || 4.7 || śrīnārāyaṇarṣiruvāca aye vipra mahābhāga saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ tava | yasminkule ca jāto'si taddhanyaṃ supraśaṃsitaṃ || 4.8 || bhaja tvaṃ paramānandaṃ sānandaṃ nandanandanaṃ | dhruvaṃ yāsyasi golokaṃ paramānandaṃ īpsitaṃ || 4.9 || tatkulaṃ pāvanaṃ dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ca nirāpadaṃ | yasminsvayaṃ bhavānjātaḥ puṇyaḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ || 4.10 || naivedyaṃ patitaṃ mārge jīrnaṃ śvāpadabhakṣitaṃ | bhuktvā tavaiṣā buddhiśca kṛṣṇabhaktirbabhūva ca || 4.11 || kṛṣṇanaivedyamāhātmyaṃ ko vatsa kathituṃ kṣamaḥ | yadvaktuṃ na hi śaktāśca vedāścatvāra eva ca || 4.12 || varaṃ vṛṇuṣva bhadraṃ te subhadra dvijapuṅgava | sarvaṃ dātuṃ ahaṃ śakto yatte manasi vāñcchitaṃ || 4.13 || nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā taṃ uvāca śiṣuḥ svayaṃ | punaḥ kampitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetraḥ puṭāñjaliḥ || 4.14 || subhadra uvāca dehi me kṛṣṇapādābje dṛḍhaṃ bhaktiṃ sudurlabhaṃ | taddāsyaṃ tatpade vāsaṃ jarāmṛtyuharaṃ paraṃ || 4.15 || anyaṃ varaṃ na gṛhṇāmi na me kiṃcitprayojanaṃ | nāhaṃ varārthī kāmī ca rāgī vetanabhugyathā || 4.16 || nārāyaṇarṣiruvāca śrīkṛṣṇo yasya bhaktiśca tasyātra kiṃ sudurlabhaṃ | aṇimādikadvatriṃśatsiddhiḥ karatale parā || 4.17 || nirvikalpo dadātyasya naiva gṛhṇāti vaiṣṇavaḥ | animittāṃ harerbhaktiṃ bhaktā vāñcchanti santataṃ || 4.18 || gṛhāṇa mantraṃ kṛṣṇasya paraṃ kalpataruṃ varaṃ | bhaktidaṃ dāsyadaṃ śuddhaṃ karmamūlanikṛntanaṃ || 4.19 || lakṣmīrmāyākāmabījaṃ ṅe'ntaṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ tathā | vahnijāyāntamantraṃ ca mantrarājaṃ manoharaṃ || 4.20 || ityevaṃ uktvā tatkarṇe kathayāṃ āsa dakṣiṇe | vāratrayaṃ muniśreṣṭhaḥ śuddhabhāvena putraka || 4.21 || yena stotreṇa tuṣṭāva subhadraḥ parameśvaraṃ | ājñāṃ cakāra sa ṛṣistadeva paṭhituṃ mudā || 4.22 || kavacaṃ ca dadau tasmai jaganmaṅgalamaṅgalaṃ | dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ sarvapūjāvidhikramaṃ || 4.23 || harerdāsyaṃ ca tadbhaktirgolokavāsaṃ īpsitaṃ | janmadvayāntare caiva karmabhogakṣaye sati || 4.24 || subhadra uvāca satyaṃ kuru mahābhāga varaṃ me yadi dāsyasi | varaṃ vṛṇomi tatpaścātyanme manasi vāñcchitaṃ || 4.25 || nārāyaṇarṣiruvāca oṃ satyaṃ vatsa dāsyāmi varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitaṃ | mamāśakyaṃ nāsti kiṃcitdātāhaṃ sarvasampadāṃ || 4.26 || subhadra uvāca kaṇṭhe te kiṃ ca kavacaṃ kasya vā sarvapūjitaṃ | amūlyaratnaguṭikāyuktaṃ ca sumanoharaṃ || 4.27 || kavacaṃ dehi me deva svasatyarakṣaṇaṃ kuru | viprasya vacanaṃ śrutvā śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhātālukaḥ || 4.28 || vaktuṃ na śaktastadvākyaṃ dadhyau kṛṣṇapadāmbujaṃ | pradadau guṭikāṃ tasmai novāca kavacaṃ muniḥ || 4.29 || taṃ uvāca maharṣiśca vituṣṭaśconmanāḥ suta | vatsa krodho hi devasya varaṃ tulyaṃ ca vāñcchitaṃ || 4.30 || nārāyaṇarṣiruvāca triṃṣatsahasravarṣaṃ ca bhuṅkṣva rājyaṃ sudurlabhaṃ | labhasva durlabhāṃ lakṣmīṃ māyayā mohito bhava || 4.31 || madiṣṭadevakavacaṃ gṛhītaṃ yena hetunā | saptakalpāntajīvasya paratra ca bhaviṣyati || 4.32 || sucireṇaiva kālena golokaṃ ca prāyasyasi | pare mṛkaṇḍuputrastvaṃ mārkaṇḍeyo bhaviṣyasi || 4.33 || mayā dattaṃ ca kavacaṃ tvāṃ ca rakṣati putraka | tava kaṇṭhe sthitiścāśya prati janmani janmani || 4.34 || punaśca guṭikāyuktaṃ kṛtvā ca kavacaṃ muniḥ | gale dadhāra bhaktyā ca tadbhakto dharmanandanaḥ || 4.35 || varaṃ datvā ca sa muniryayau gehaṃ sa unmanāḥ | viprāya kavacaṃ datvā naṣṭavatsā gauryathā || 4.36 || bhrātrā nareṇa pitrā ca dharmeṇa ca mahātmanā | mātrā mūrtyā ca patnyā ca śāntyā ca bhartsito muniḥ || 4.37 || vipraḥ samprāpya kavacaṃ mantraṃ kalpataruṃ paraṃ | sarovarātsamutthāya prajvalanbrahmatejasā || 4.38 || kṣaṇaṃ tasthau sarastīre vaṭamūle manohare | jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ sampūjya jagadīśvaraṃ || 4.39 || atha tattātavipro hi samanviṣya sutaṃ ciraṃ | gatvā ca svagṛhaṃ duḥkhī śokārtaḥ sa ruroda ca || 4.40 || samudyatā tanuṃ tyaktuṃ tanmātā putravārtayā | na tatyāja tanuṃ vipro dṛṣṭvā susvapnaṃ uttamaṃ || 4.41 || vipro viprā gṛhaṃ tyaktvā putrānveṣaṇapūrvakaṃ | prayayau kānanaṃ ghoraṃ sarvaiśca bāndhavaiḥ sahaḥ || 4.42 || sarvaṃ vanaṃ samanviṣya prayayuste sarovaraṃ | dadṛśuste śiśuṃ gṛhyaṃ sūryābhaṃ vaṭamūlake || 4.43 || cucumba gaṇḍaṃ putrasya vipro viprā ca sāradaṃ | āśiśleṣa krameṇaiva mātā tātaḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 4.44 || putraśca sarvavṛttāntaṃ kathayāṃ āsa sādaraṃ | śrutvā putrasya vipraśca viprā bāndhavastathā || 4. 45 || yayuḥ sarve svadeśaṃ ca paramāhlādamānasāḥ | candrabhāgāṃ samuttīrya viveśa nagaraṃ paraṃ || 4.46 || nagarastho nṛpendraśca dṛṣṭvā tejasvinaṃ śiśuṃ | dadau tasmai svakanyāṃ ca ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitaṃ || 4.47 || yuvatīṃ sundarīṃ śyāmāṃ taptakañcanasaṃnibhāṃ | pativratāṃ mahābhāgāṃ sundarīṃ kamalākalāṃ || 4.48 || gajendrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca pradadau yautukaṃ mudā | aśvānāṃ daśalakṣaṃ ca ratnānāṃ ca sahasrakaṃ || 4.49 || dāsīnāṃ niṣkakaṇṭhīnāṃ saundarīṇāṃ sahasrakaṃ | vastraratnasahasraṃ ca bahumūlyaṃ sudurlabhaṃ || 4.50 || dāsānāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca padātīnāṃ trilakṣakaṃ | daśalakṣaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca ratnamālāṃ sudurlabhāṃ || 4.51 || datvā tasmai ca kanyāṃ ca ruroda ca sabhāryakaḥ | rājā ca kanyayā sārdhaṃ prayayau vipramandiraṃ || 4.52 || gatvā cāpi kiyaddūraṃ dadarśa nagaraṃ nṛpaḥ | atīva sundaraṃ ramyaṃ vijitya cāmarāvatīṃ || 4.53 || śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ ratnasāravinirmitaṃ | trikoṭicaṭṭālikāgehaṃ navakoṭisumandiraṃ || 4.54 || saptaprākārayuktaṃ ca parikhātrayasamyuktaṃ | durlaṅghyaṃ atidurgamyaṃ ripūṇāṃ api putraka || 4.55 || śiśośca svāśramaṃ ramyaṃ sadratnasāranirmitaṃ | sphuratvajrakapāṭaṃ ca ratnendrakalaśānvitaṃ || 4.56 || sadratnadarpaṇāirdīpaṃ ratnakumbhairvirājitaṃ | prāṅgaṇaṃ ratnasārāḍhyaṃ ratnasopānaśobhitaṃ || 4.57 || manoharaṃ rājamārgaṃ sindūrādipariṣkṛtaṃ | prākāraṃ maṇibhūṣāḍhyaṃ uccairākāśasparśi ca || 4.58 || jagāma vismayaṃ rājā dṛṣṭvā nagaraṃ uttamaṃ | pitrā mātrā saha śiśurvismayaṃ ca yayau mudā || 4.59 || gajendrāṇāṃ trilakṣaṃ ca śvānāṃ śatalakṣakaṃ | caturguṇaṃ padātīnāṃ āyayuste'pyanuvrajaṃ || 4.60 || vāraṇendraṃ puraskṛtya veśyāṃ ca nartakaṃ tathā | dvijāṃśca pūrṇakumbhāṃśca patiputravatīṃ satīṃ || 4.61 || mahāpātraḥ śiśuṃ dṛṣṭvā gajendroparisaṃsthitaṃ | mūrdhnā nanāma vegenāpyavaruhya gajādapi || 4.62 || śiśuṃ praveśayāṃ āsa ratnanirmāṇamandiraṃ | ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ tasmai pradadau sādaraṃ mudā || 4.63 || kanyādātre ca pitre ca mātre ca sādaraṃ mudā | ratnasiṃḥāsanaṃ ramyaṃ pradadau pātra eva ca || 4.64 || śiśuṃ siṣeva pātraśca svayaṃ ca śvetacāmaraiḥ | dadhāra ratnachatraṃ ca hīrāhārapariṣkṛtaṃ || 4.65 || uvāsa sa sabhāryāṃ ca sudharmyāṃ mahendravath | śvasuraśca yayau gehaṃ śiśunā ca puraskṛtaḥ || 4.66 || triṃśatsahasravarṣaṃ ca rājā rājyaṃ cakāra saḥ | kālāntare tatpitā ca vane vyāghreṇa bhakṣitaḥ || 4.67 || pativratā mahābhāgā mātā sahamṛtā suta | ratnayānena ramyeṇa sastrīkaḥ kṛṣṇamandiraṃ || 4.68 || prayayau sādaraṃ vipraḥ kṛṣṇanaivedyabhakṣaṇāth | tadasthi bhuktvā vyāghraśca pūtaḥ sadyaśca sāṃprataṃ || 4.69 || tābhyāṃ sārdhaṃ ca prayayau golokaṃ sumanoharaṃ | śiśurdehaṃ parityajya himādrau svarṇadītaṭe || 4.70 || datvā putrāya rājyaṃ ca svargādapi sudurlabhaṃ | mṛkaṇḍupatnīgarbhe ca lebhe janma svakarmaṇā || 4.71 || mārkaṇḍeyo muniśreṣṭho babhūva parajanmani | saptakalpāntajīvī ca nārāyaṇavareṇa saḥ || 4.72 || babhūva sāṃprataṃ vipraḥ kṛṣṇanaivedyabhakṣaṇāth | śvabhakṣitaṃ ca naivedyaṃ bhuktvā cedīdṛśī gatiḥ | akāmataścāpyajñāto jīrṇamārgasthitaṃ suta || 4.73 || yo bhakṣetkāmato jñāto nityaṃ naivedyaṃ īpsitaṃ | na jānanti gatistasya vedāścatvāra eva ca || 4.74 || iti te kathitaṃ brahmannitihāsaṃ purātanaṃ | āścaryaṃ madhuraṃ ramyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotuṃ icchasi || 4.75 || śrīnārada uvāca śrutaṃ naivedyamāhātmyaṃ atīva sumanoharaṃ | īśvarasyāpi he tāta kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ || 4.76 || adhunā śrotuṃ icchāmi svātmasandehabhañjanaṃ | nārāyaṇarṣerkaṇṭhe ca kavacaṃ tasya tadvada || 4.77 || atha kavacapraśnaḥ sanatkumāra uvāca mamāpyastīti sandeho vacane prapitāmaha | kasya tatkavacaṃ brahmannidaṃ vaktuṃ tvaṃ arhasi || 4.78 || sa pitā sa guruḥ svacchaḥ karoti bhramabhañjanaṃ | śīghraṃ brūhi mahābhāga nāradaṃ māṃ sutapriya || 4.79 || putrayośca vacaḥ śrutvā śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ | uvāca vacanaṃ brahmā smarankṛṣṇapadāmbujaṃ || 4.80 || brahmovāca nārāyaṇena muninā jaganmaṅgalamaṅgalaṃ | viprāya kavacaṃ dattaṃ dhyānaṃ ca parmātmanaḥ || 4.81 || tadbravīmi mahābhāga tvāṃ eva nāradaṃ prati | kaṇṭhasthaṃ kavacaṃ vaktuṃ naiva śaknomi sāṃprataṃ || 4.82 || matkaṇṭhe kavacaṃ yasya gopanīyaṃ sudurlabhaṃ | nārāyaṇarṣikaṇṭhe ca tadeva paramādbhutaṃ || 4.83 || tadeva dharmakaṇṭhe ca narasya ca mahātmanaḥ | agastyasya ca kaṇṭhe ca lomaśasya mahāmuneḥ || 4.84 || tulasyāścāpi saṃjñāyāḥ sāvitryāścāpi putraka | anyeṣāṃ ca bhāgyavatāṃ bhārate ca sudurlabhe || 4.85 || nārada uvāca paścātśroṣyāmi kavacaṃ jaganmaṅgalamaṅgalaṃ | dhyānaṃ pūjāṃ vidhānaṃ ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ || 4.86 || ādau kathaya bhadraṃ te paraṃ paramabhadrakaṃ | subhadraprāptaṃ kavacaṃ māhātmyaṃ yasya durlabhaṃ || 4.87 || brahmovāca subhadraprāptaṃ kavacaṃ paścātśroṣyasi putraka | śaṅkarasya mukhādvipra svagurorjñāninastathā || 4.88 || iti śrīnāradapañcarātre jñānāmṛtasāre brahmānāradasaṃvāde <5> prathamaikarātre kavacapraśno nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ prathamaikarātre pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ śrīsanatkumāra uvāca tavecchā yatra kavace dhyāne tadvada sāmprataṃ | yacchṛṇomi śubhaṃ tacca kena śreyasi tṛpyate || 5.1 || bramovāca dhyānaṃ sāmavedoktaṃ dattaṃ nārāyaṇena vai | kavacaṃ ca subhadrāya dharmiṣṭhāya mahātmane || 5.2 || navīnajaladaśyāmaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasaṃ | candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ sasmitaṃ śyāmasundaraṃ || 5.3 || mālatīmālyabhūṣāḍhyaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaṃ | munīndreśasusiddheśabrahmeśaśeṣavanditaṃ || 5.4 || sarvasvarūpaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvabījaṃ sanātanaṃ | sarvādyaṃ sarvajñaṃ puruṣaṃ prakṛteḥ paraṃ || 5.5 || nirguṇaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca nirliptaṃ īsvaraṃ bhaje | dhyātvā mūlena tasmai ca dadyātpādyādikaṃ mudā || 5.6 || tataḥ stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ bhaktyā ca prapaṭhennaraḥ | japtvā ca mantraṃ bhaktyā daṇḍavatpraṇamedbhuvi | iti te kathitaṃ vatsa kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotuṃ icchasi || 5.7 || śrīsanatkumāra uvāca brūhi me kavacaṃ brahmanjaganmaṅgalamaṅgalaṃ | pūjyaṃ puṇyasvarūpaṃ ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ || 5.8 || atha jaganmaṅgalamaṅgalakavacam brahmovāca śṛṇu vakṣyāmi viprendra kavacaṃ paramādbhutaṃ | śrīkṛṣṇenaiva kathitaṃ mahyaṃ ca kṛpayā parā || 5.9 || mayā dattaṃ ca dharmāya tena nārāyaṇarṣaye | ṛṣiṇā tena taddattaṃ subhadrāya mahātmane || 5.10 || atiguhyatamaṃ śuddhaṃ paraṃ snehādvadāmyahaṃ | yaddhṛtvā paṭhanātsiddhāḥ siddhāni prāpnuvanti ca || 5.11 || evaṃ indrādayaḥ sarve sarvaiśvaryaṃ āpnuyuḥ | ṛṣiśchandaśca sāvitrī devo nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ || 5.12 || dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | rādheśo me śiraḥ pātu kaṇṭhaṃ radheśvaraḥ || 5.13 || gopīśaścakṣuṣī pātu tālu ca bhagavānsvayaṃ | gaṇḍayugmaṃ ca govindaḥ karṇayugmaṃ ca keśavaḥ || 5.14 || galaṃ gadādharaḥ pātu skandhaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | vakṣasthalaṃ vāsudevaścodaraṃ cāpi so'cyutaḥ || 5.15 || nabhiṃ pātu padmanābhaḥ kaṅkālaṃ kaṃsasūdanaḥ | puruṣottamaḥ pātu pṛṣṭhaṃ nityānando nitambakaṃ || 5.16 || puṇḍarīkaḥ pādayugmaṃ hastayugmaṃ hariḥ svayaṃ | nāsāṃ ca nakharaṃ pātu narasiṃhaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ || 5.17 || sarveśvaraśca sarvāṅgaṃ santataṃ madhusūdanaḥ | prācyāṃ pātu ca rāmaśca vahnau ca vaṃśīdharaḥ svayaṃ || 5.18 || pātu dāmodaro dakṣe nairṛte ca narottmaḥ | paścime puṇḍarīkākṣo vāyavyāṃ vāmanaḥ svayaṃ || 5.19 || anantaścottare pātu aiśānyāṃ īśvaraḥ svayaṃ | jale sthale cāntarīkṣe svapne jāgaraṇe tathā || 5.20 || pātu vṛndāvaneśaśca māṃ bhaktaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ | iti te kathitaṃ vatsa kavacaṃ paramādbhutaṃ || 5.21 || sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ satāṃ | idaṃ kavacaṃ iṣṭaṃ ca pūjākāle ca yaḥ paṭheth || 5.22 || haridāsyaṃ avāpnoti goloke vāsaṃ uttamaṃ | ihaiva haribhaktiṃ ca jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ || 5.23 || nārada uvāca nārāyaṇarṣiṇā dattaṃ kavacaṃ yatsudurlabhaṃ | subhadrāya brāhmaṇāya tanme vaktuṃ ihārhasi || 5.24 || brahmovāca madiṣṭadevyāḥ kavacaṃ kathaṃ tatkathayāmi hīrāsāravinirmāṇaṃ sucārukalaśojjvalaṃ | ratnapradīpadīptāḍhyaṃ ratnadarpaṇabhūṣitaṃ || 7.48 || muktāśuktinibaddhaiśca śobhitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ | māṇikyasārahāreṇa maṇirājairvirājitaṃ || 7.49 || pārijāṭaprasūtānāṃ māyājālaiḥ pariṣkṛtaṃ | grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍaṃ sahasrasadṛśojjvalaṃ || 7.50 || īśvarecchāvinirmāṇaṃ kāmapuraṃ ca kāmināṃ | sarvabhogasamāviṣṭaṃ kalpavṛkṣaparaṃ varaṃ || 7.51 || sasaktacitritai ramyai ratimandirasundaraiḥ | golokādāgataṃ pūrvaṃ krīḍārthaṃ śaṅkarasya ca || 7.52 || vivāhe pariniṣpanne pārvatīparameśayoḥ | rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca prayayau kiyaddūraṃ mahāmuniḥ || 7.53 || atīva ramyaṃ ruciraṃ dadarśa śaṅkarāśramaṃ | ratnendrasāranirmāṇaṃ śiviraiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ || 7.54 || mitaistasmātśataguṇaistatra sundaramandiraiḥ | yuktaṃ ratnakapāṭaiśca ratnadhātuvicitritaiḥ || 7.55 || paramastambhasopānairvajramiśrairvibhūṣitaṃ | dadarśa śiviraṃ śambhoḥ parikhābhistribhiryutaṃ || 7.56 || durlaghyābhirāmitrāṇāṃ sugamyābhiḥ satāṃ aho | prakāraiśca tribhiryuktaṃ dhanurlakṣocchritaṃ suta || 7.57 || sammitaṃ saptabhirdvārairnānārakṣakarakṣitaiḥ | dhanuḥśatasahasraṃ ca caturasraṃ ca sammitaṃ || 7.58 || amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ catuḥśālāśatairyutaṃ | atīva ramyaṃ purato puradvāraṃ dadarśa saḥ || 7.59 || purato ratnabhittau ca kṛtrimaṃ ca suśobhitaṃ | puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ tanmadhye rāsamaṇḍalaṃ || 7.60 || sarvatra rādhākṛṣṇaṃ ca pratyekaṃ ratimandire | ramyaṃ kuñjakuṭīrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ sumanoharaṃ || 7.61 || sugandhi puṣpaśayyānāṃ sahasraṃ candanokṣitaṃ | dvārapālaṃ ca tatraiva maṇibhadraṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ || 7.62 || triśūlapaṭṭiśadharaṃ vyāghracarmāmbaraṃ paraṃ | taṃ saṃbhāṣya vilokyaivaṃ dvitīyadvāraṃ īpsitaṃ || 7.63 || jagāma ca muniśreṣṭho dadarśa citraṃ uttamaṃ | kadambānāṃ samūhaṃ ca tanmūlaṃ ca manoharaṃ || 7.64 || ratnabhittisamāyuktaṃ kālindīkūlaṃ uttamaṃ | snātaṃ gopīsamūhaṃ ca nagnasarvāṅgaṃ adbhutaṃ || 7.65 || kadambāgre ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vastrapuñjakaraṃ paraṃ | tatraiva śūlahastaṃ ca mahākālaṃ dadarśa ca || 7.66 || kṛpāluṃ dvārapālaṃ taṃ saṃbhāṣya nārado muniḥ | prayayau śīghragāmī sa tṛtīyadvāraṃ uttamaṃ || 7.67 || dadarśa tatra purataḥ kṛtrimaṃ vaṭamūlakaṃ | gopānāṃ ca samūhaṃ ca pītambaradharaṃ paraṃ || 7.68 || bālakrīḍāṃ ca kurvantaṃ tanmadhye kṛṣṇaṃ uttamaṃ | brāhmaṇībhiḥ pradattaṃ ca bhuktavantaṃ supāyasaṃ || 7.69 || kurvantaṃ ca samādhānaṃ muneḥ vāmakareṇa ca | gṛhītvā tadanujñāṃ ca caturthaṃ dvāraṃ īpsitaṃ || 7.70 || prayayau brahmaputraśca dadarśa citraṃ uttamaṃ | govardhanaṃ parvataṃ ca tatra kṛṣṇakarasthitaṃ || 7.71 || gokulaṃ gokulasthānāṃ gopīnāṃ caiva rakṣaṇaṃ | vyākulaṃ gokulaṃ bhītaṃ śakravṛṣṭibhayena ca || 7.72 || abhayaṃ dattavantaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ dakṣakareṇa ca | nandinaṃ dvārapālaṃ ca śūlahastaṃ ca sasmitaṃ || 7.73 || vilokya prayayau vipraḥ pañcamaṃ dvāṛaṃ uttamaṃ | nānākṛtimacitrāḍhyaṃ vīrabhadrānvitaṃ paraṃ || 7.74 || tatraiva nīpamūlaṃ ca yamunākulaṃ eva ca | kālīyadamanaṃ tatra kṛtimaṃ ca dadarśa ḥa || 7.75 || taddṛṣṭvā sasmitastuṣṭaḥ ṣaṣṭadvāṛaṃ jagāma saḥ | dvāre niyuktaṃ bālaṃ ca śūlahastaṃ caturbhujaṃ || 7.76 || ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca sasmitaṃ svagaṇādhipaṃ | dadarśa citraṃ tatraiva mathurāgamanaṃ hareḥ || 7.77 || gopikānāṃ vilāpaṃ ca yaśodānandayostathā | vyākulaṃ gokulaṃ cāpi rathasthaṃ śaraṇaṃ hariṃ || 7.78 | || akrūraṃ ca tathā nandaṃ nirānandaṃ śucākulaṃ | taddṛṣṭvā saptamadvāraṃ dvārapālaṃ dadarśa saḥ || 7.79 || citraṃ kautukayuktaṃ ca mathurāyāḥ praveśanaṃ | sabalaṃ gopasahitaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prakṛteḥ paraṃ || 7.80 || mathurānāgarībhiśca bālakairvānirargalaiḥ | vīkṣantaṃ sādaraṃ sarvairnagarasthairmanoharaṃ || 7.81 || dhanurbhaṅgaṃ tathā śaṃbhoḥ kaṃsādinidhanādikaṃ | sabhāryaṃ vasudevaṃ ca nigaḍānmuktaṃ īpsitaṃ || 7.82 || dvāre niyuktaṃ deveśaṃ gaṇeśaṃ gaṇasaṃyutaṃ | dhyānasthaṃ ca vibhāntaṃ ca śuddhasphaṭikamālayā || 7.83 || japantaṃ paramaṃ śuddhaṃ brahmajyotiḥ sanātanaṃ | nirliptaṃ nirguṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paramaṃ prakṛteḥ paraṃ || 7.84 || dṛṣṭvā taṃ ca suraśreṣṭhaṃ muniśreṣṭho'pi nāradaḥ | sāmavedoktastotreṇa puṣṭāva parameśvaraṃ | sāśrunetraḥ pulakito bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ || 7.85 || atha gaṇapatistotram bho gaṇeśa suraśreṣṭha lambodara parātpara | heramba maṅgalārambha gajavaktra trilocana || 7.86 || muktida śubhada śrīda śrīdharasmaraṇe rata | paramānanda parama pārvatīnandana svayaṃ || 7.87 || sarvatra pūjya sarveśa jagatpūjya mahāmate | jagadguro jagannātha jagadīśa namo'stu te ||7.88 || yatpūjā sarvaparato yaḥ stutaḥ sarvayogibhiḥ | yaḥ pūjitaḥ surendraiśca munīndraistaṃ namāmyahaṃ || 7.89 || paramārādhanenaiva kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ | puṇyakena vratenaiva yaṃ prāpa pārvatī satī || 7.90 || taṃ namāmi suraśreṣṭhaṃ sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ gariṣṭhakaṃ | jñāniśreṣṭhaṃ variṣṭhaṃ ca taṃ namāmi gaṇeśvaraṃ || 7.91 || ityevaṃ uktvā devarṣistatraivāntardadhe vibhuḥ | nāradaḥ prayayau śīghraṃ īśvarābhyantaraṃ mudā || 7.92 || idaṃ lambodarastotraṃ nāradena kṛtaṃ purā | pūjākāle paṭhennityaṃ jayastasya pade pade || 7.93 || saṃkalpitaṃ paṭhedyo hi varṣaṃ ekaṃ susaṃyataḥ | viśiṣṭaputraṃ labhate paraṃ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaṃ || 7.94 || yaśasvinaṃ ca vidvāṃsaṃ dhaninaṃ cirajīvinaṃ | vighnanāśo bhavettasya mahaiśvaryaṃ yaśo'malaṃ | ihaiva ca sukhaṃ bhaktyānte yāti hareḥ padaṃ || 7.95 || iti śrīnāradapañcarātre jñānāmṛtasāre prathamaikarātre gaṇapatistotraṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ <8> prathamaikarātre aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ śrīvyāsa uvāca atha cābhyantaraṃ gatvā nārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥ | dadarśa svāśramaṃ ramyaṃ atīva sumanoharaṃ || 8.1 || payaḥ phenanibhaśayyāsahitaṃ ratnamandiraṃ | sākṣādgorocanābhaiśca maṇistambhairvibhūṣitaṃ || 8.2 || maṇīndrasārasopānaiḥ kapāṭaiśca pariṣkṛtaṃ | muktāmāṇikyahīrāṇāṃ mālārājivirājitaṃ || 8.3 || śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ prāṅgaṇaṃ maṇisaṃskṛtaṃ | sundaraṃ mandiracayaṃ sadratnakalaśojjvalaṃ || 8.4 || ratnapatrapaṭākīrṇaṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitaṃ | sudhānāṃ ca madhūnāṃ ca pūrṇakumbhakaṃ śataṃ śataṃ || 8.5 || dāsadāsīsamūhaiśca ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitaiḥ | pārvatīpriyasaṅgaiśca svakarmākulasaṅkalpaṃ || 8.6 || taddṛṣṭvā ca muniśreṣṭhastatparābhyantaraṃ yayau | ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca śaṅkaraṃ ca dadarśa saḥ || 8.7 || vyāghracarmāmbaradharaṃ sasmitaṃ candraśekharaṃ | prasannavadanaṃ svacchaṃ śāntaṃ śrīmantaṃ īśvaraṃ || 8.8 || vibhūtibhūṣitāṅgaṃ ca paraṃ gaṅgājaṭādharaṃ | bhaktapriyaṃ ca bhakteśaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā || 8.9 || trinetraṃ pañcavaktraṃ ca koṭicandrasamaprabhaṃ | japantaṃ paramātmānaṃ brahma jyotiḥ sanātanaṃ || 8.10 || nirliptaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca dātāraṃ sarvasampadāṃ | svecchāmayaṃ sarvabījaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prakṛteḥ paraṃ || 8.11 || siddhendraiśca munīndraiśca devendraiḥ parisevitaṃ | pārśvadapravaraśreṣṭhasevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ || 8.12 || durgāsevitapādābjaṃ bhadrakālīpariṣṭutaṃ | purato hi vasantaṃ taṃ skandaṃ gaṇapatīṃ tathā || 8.13 || gale baddhvā ca vasanaṃ bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ | yogīndraṃ svaguruṃ śaṃbhuṃ śirasā praṇanāma saḥ || 8.14 || tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā devarṣirjagatāṃ patiṃ | svaguruṃ ca paśupatiṃ vedoktena stavena ca || 8.15 || śrīnārada uvāca namastubhyaṃ jagannātha mama nātha mama prabho | bhavarūpatarorbīja phalarūpa phalaprada || 8.16 || abījaja praja prāja sarvabīja namo'stu te | sadbhāva paramābhāva vibhāva bhāvanāśraya || 8.17 || bhaveśa bhavabandheśa bhāvābdhināvināyaka | sarvādhāra nirādhāra sādhāra dharaṇīdhara || 8.18 || vedavidyādhārādhāra gaṅādhara namo'stu te | jayeśa vijayādhāra jayabīja jayātmaka || 8.19 || jagadāde jayānanda sarvānanda namo'stu te | ityevaṃ uktvā devarṣiḥ śambhośca purataḥ sthitaḥ | prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānbhagavāṃstaṃ uvāca saḥ || 8.20 || śrīmahādeva uvāca varaṃ vṛṇu mahābhāga yatte manasi vartate | dāsyāmi tvāṃ dhruvaṃ putra dātāhaṃ sarvasaṃpadāṃ || 8.21 || sukhaṃ muktiṃ harerbhaktiṃ niścalāṃ avināśinīṃ | hareḥ pādaṃ taddāsyaṃ sālokyādicatuṣṭayaṃ || 8.22 || indratvaṃ amaratvaṃ vā yamatvaṃ anileśvaraṃ | prajāpatitvaṃ brahmatvaṃ siddhatvaṃ siddhasādhanaṃ || 8.23 || siddhaiśvaryaṃ siddhibījaṃ vedavidyādhipaṃ paraṃ | aṇimādikasiddhiṃ ca manoyāyitvaṃ īpsitaṃ || 8.24 || hareḥ padaṃ ca gamanaṃ saśarīreṇa līlayā | eteṣu vāñchitārtheṣu kiṃ vā te vāñchitaṃ suta || 8.25 || tanme brūhi muniśreṣṭha sarvaṃ dātuṃ ahaṃ kṣamaḥ | śaṅkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā taṃ uvāca mahāmuniḥ || 8.26 || śrīnārada uvāca dehi me haribhaktiṃ ca tannāmasevane ruciḥ | atitṛṣṇā guṇākhyāne nityaṃ astu mameśvara || 8.27 || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā jahāsa śaṅkaraḥ svayaṃ | pārvatī bhadrakālī ca kārttikeyo gaṇeśvaraḥ || 8.28 || sarvaṃ dadau mahādevo nāradāya ca dhīmate | sarvapradastu sarveśaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇaḥ || 8.29 || nāradena kṛtaṃ stotraṃ nityaṃ yaḥ prapaṭhetśuciḥ | haribhaktirbhavettasya tannāmni guṇato ruciḥ || 8.30 || daśavārajapenaiva stotrasiddhirbhavennṛṇāṃ | sarvasiddhirbhavettasya siddhastotro bhavedyadi || 8.31 || iha prāpnoti lakṣmīṃ ca niścalāṃ lakṣapauruṣīṃ | paripūrṇaṃ ahaiśvaryaṃ ante yāti hareḥ padaṃ || 8.32 || putraṃ viśiṣṭaṃ labhate haribhaktaṃ jitendriyaṃ | susādhyāṃ suvinītāṃ suvratāṃ ca pativratāṃ || 8.33 || prajāṃ bhūmiṃ yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ vidyāṃ sakavitāṃ labheth | prasūyate mahābandhyā varṣaṃ ekaṃ śṛṇoti ceth || 8.34 || galatkuṣṭhī mahārogī sadyo rogātpramucyate | dhanī mahādaridraśca kṛpaṇaḥ satyavānbhaveth | vipradgrasto rājabaddho mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 8.35 || iti śrīnāradapañcarātre jñānāmṛtasāre prathamaikarātre aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ <9> prathamaikarātre navamo'dhyāyaḥ śrīvyāsa uvāca varaṃ datvā mahādevo bhaktyā taṃ brāhmaṇātithiṃ | pūjāṃ cakāra vedoktāṃ svayaṃ vedavidāṃ varaḥ || 9.1 || bhuktvā pītvā muniśreṣṭho mahādevasya mandire | tiṣṭhannupāsānāṃ cakre pārvatīparameśayoḥ || 9.2 || ekadā cirakālānte taṃ uvāca mahāmuniṃ | mahādevaḥ sabhāmadhye kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ || 9.3 || śrīmahādeva uvāca kiṃ vā te vāñchitaṃ vatsa brūhi māṃ yadi rocate | varo dattaḥ kiṃ aparaṃ yatte manasi vartate || 9.4 || mahādevavacaḥ śrutvā taṃ uvāca mahāmuniḥ | kailāse ca sabhāmadhye yattanmanasi vāñchitaṃ || 9.5 || śrīnārada uvāca jñānaṃ ādhyātmikaṃ nāma vedasāraṃ manoharaṃ | haribhaktipradaṃ jñānaṃ muktidaṃ jñānaṃ īpsitaṃ || 9.6 || yogayuktaṃ ca yajjñānaṃ jñānaṃ yatsiddhidaṃ tathā | saṃsāraviṣayajñānaṃ eva pañcavidhaṃ smṛtaṃ || 9.7 || āśramāṇāṃ samācāraṃ teṣāṃ dharmapariṣkṛtaṃ | vidhavānāṃ ca bhikṣūṇāṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇāṃ || 9.8 || pūjāvidhānaṃ kṛṣṇasya tatstotraṃ kavacaṃ manuṃ | puraścaryāvidhānaṃ ca sarvāhnikaṃ abhīpsitaṃ || 9.9 || jīvakarmavipākaṃ ca karmamūlanikṛntanaṃ | saṃsāravāsanāṃ kāṃ vā lakṣaṇaṃ prakṛtīśayoḥ || 9.10 || tayoḥ paraṃ vā kiṃ vastu tasyāvatāravarṇamaṃ | ko vā tadaṃśaḥ kaḥ pūrṇaḥ paripūrṇatamaśca kaḥ || 9.11 || nārāyaṇarṣikavacaṃ subhadrapravarāya ca | yaddattaṃ kiṃ taddeveśa tadārādhyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 9.12 || mayā jñānaṃṃ anāpṛṣṭhaṃ yadyadasti surottama | tanme kathaya tattvena māṃ evānugrahaṃ kuru || 9.13 || gurośca jñānodgiraṇājjñānaṃ syānmantratantrayoḥ | tattantraṃ sa ca mantraḥ syādyato bhaktiradhokṣaje || 9.14 || jñānaṃ syādviduṣāṃ kiṃcidvedavyākhyānacintayā | svayaṃ bhavānvedakartā jñānādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā || 9.15 || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā sasmitaḥ pārvatīpatiḥ | nirīkṣya pārvatīvaktraṃ gajavaktraṃ uvāca saḥ || 9.16 || atha nāradopadeśagrahaṇam śrīmahādeva uvāca aho anantadāsānāṃ māhātmyaṃ paramādbhutaṃ | kurvantyahaitukīṃ bhaktiṃ ye ca śaśvaddhareḥ pade || 9.17 || padmanābhapādapadmaṃ padmāpadmeśvarārcitaṃ | divāniśaṃ ye dhyāyante śeṣādisuravanditaṃ || 9.18 || ālāpaṃ gātrasaṃsparśaṃ pādareṇuṃ abhīpsitaṃ | vāñchantyeva hi tīrthāni vasudhā cātmaśuddhaye || 9.19 || kṛṣṇamantropāsakānāṃ śuddhaṃ pādodakaṃ suta | punāti sarvatīrthāni vasudhāṃ api pārvati || 9.20 || kṛṣṇamantro dvijamukhādyasya karṇaṃ prayāti ca | taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ jagatpūtaṃ pravadanti purāvidaḥ || 9.21 || mantragrahaṇamātreṇa naro nārāyanātmakaḥ | punāti līlāmātreṇa puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ śataṃ || 9.22 || yajjanmamātrātpūtaṃ ca tatpitṛṇāṃ śataṃ śataṃ | prayāti sadyo golokaṃ karmabhogātpramucyate || 9.23 || mātāmahādikānsapta janmamātrātsamuddhareth | yatkanyāṃ pratigṛhṇāti tasya saptāvalīlayā || 9.24 || mātaraṃ tatpraśūṃ bhāryāṃ putrācca saptapūruṣaṃ | bhrātaraṃ bhaginīṃ kanyāṃ kṛṣṇabhaktaḥ samuddhareth || 9.24 || sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ | phalaṃ sa lebhe pūjānāṃ vratī sarvavrateṣu ca || 9.26 || viṣṇumantraṃ yo labhetvaiṣṇavācca dvijottamāth | koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 9.27 || kṛṣṇamantropāsakānāṃ sadyo darśanamātrataḥ | śatajanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 9.28 || vaiṣṇavāddarśanenaiva sparśanena ca pārvati | sadyaḥ pūtaṃ jalaṃ vahnirjagatpūtaḥ samīraṇaḥ || 9.29 || darśanaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca devā vāñchanti nityaśaḥ | na vaiṣṇavātparaḥ pūto viśveṣu nikhileṣu ca || 9.30 || ityuktvā saṅkaraḥ śīghraṃ nāradena sahātmajaḥ | yayau mandākinītīraṃ nīraṃ kṣīropamaṃ paraṃ || 9.31 || tatra snāto mahādevī nāradaśca mahāmuniḥ | samācāntaḥ śucistatra dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsavī || 9.32 || kṛṣṇamantraṃ dadau tasmai nāradāya maheśvaraḥ | paraṃ kaplataruvaraṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ śuka || 9.33 || lakṣmīrmāyākāmabījaṃ ṅentaṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ tataḥ | jagatpūtapriyāntaṃ ca mantrarājaṃ prakīrtitaṃ || 9.34 || mantraṃ gṛhītvā sa muniḥ śivaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ | sapta vārānnamaskṛtya svātmānaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadau || 9.35 || tatpādapadme vikrītamājanma mastakaṃ paraṃ | muninā bhaktiyuktena svargamandākinītaṭe || 9.36 || etasminnantare vatsa puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha | nāradopari tatraiva suśrāva dundubhirmuniḥ || 9.37 || nanarta brahmaṇaḥ putro brahmaloke nirāmaye | brahmā jagāma tatraiva suprasannaśca sasmitaḥ || 9.38 || putraṃ śubhāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā tuṣṭāva candraśekharaṃ | śambhuśca prathamaikarātre daśamo'dhyāyaḥ śrīśuka uvāca nārado hi mahājñānī devarṣirbrahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ | sarvavedavidāṃ śreṣṭho gariṣṭhaśca variṣṭhakaḥ || 10.1 || kathaṃ sa nopadiṣṭaśca jñānahīno mahāmuniḥ | tanmāṃ bodhaya vibho sandehabhañjanaṃ kuru || 10.2 || śrīvyāsa uvāca nārado brahmaṇaḥ putraḥ purākalpe babhūva saḥ | sarvajñānaṃ dadau tasmai vidhātā jagatāṃ api || 10.3 || vedāṃśca pāṭhayāṃ āsa stanadātrī garbhadhātrī snehakartrī sadāmbikā | janmadātānnadātā syātsnehakartā pitā sadā || 10.8 || na kṣamau tau ca pitarau putrasya karma khaṇḍituṃ | karoti sadguruḥ śiṣyakarmamūlanikṛntanaṃ || 10.9 || guruśca jñānodgiraṇātjñānaṃ syānmantratantrayoḥ | tattantraṃ sa ca mantraśca kṛṣṇabhaktiryato bhaveth || 10.10 || śrīkṛṣṇavimukho bhūtvā viṣaye yasya mānasaṃ | viṣaṃ atyamṛtaṃ tyaktvā sa ca mūḍho narādhamaḥ || 10.11 || sa guruḥ sa pitā vandyaḥ sā mātā sa patiḥ sutaḥ | yo dadāti harau bhaktiṃ karmamūlanikṛntanī || 10.12 || śrīkṛṣṇabhajanaṃ tāta sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalaṃ | karmopabhogaroga'ṇāṃ auṣadhaṃ tannikṛntanaṃ || 10.13 || aho jagadvidhātuśca dharmaśāsturiyaṃ matiḥ | svayaṃ māyāmohitaśca paraṃ bhraṣṭaṃ karoti ca || 10.14 || viṣṇustvāṃ mohitāṃ kṛtvā yuyoja sraṣṭuṃ īśvaraḥ | na dadau svātmabhaktiṃ tāṃ svadāsyaṃ cātidurlabhaṃ || 10.15 || mātā dadāti putrāya modakaṃ kṣunnivārakaṃ | sa ca bālo na jānāti kathaṃbhūtaṃ ca modakaṃ || 10.16 || bālakaṃ vañcanaṃ kṛtvā miṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ pradāya saḥ | pitā prayāti kāryārthaṃ viṣṇunā mohitastathā || 10.17 || saṃsārakūpapatito viṣṇunā prerito bhavān | na yuktaṃ patanaṃ tatra taduddhāraṃ abhīpsitaṃ || 10.18 || jñānī guruśca balavānbhavābdheḥ śiṣyaṃ uddhareth | guruḥ svayaṃ asiddhaśca durbalaḥ kathaṃ uddhareth || 10.19 || guroratyavaliptasya kāryākāryaṃ ajānataḥ | utpathapratipannasya parityāgo vidhīyate || 10.20 || sa guruḥ paramo vairī yo dadāti hyasanmatiṃ | taṃ namaskṛtya satśiṣyaḥ prayāti jñānadaṃ guruṃ || 10.21 || saṃsāraviṣayonmatto gururārtaḥ svakarmaṇi | durbalo durvahaṃ bhāraṃ dadāti janakāya ca || 10.22 || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā kruddhaḥ putraṃ uvāca saḥ | kampitastamasā dhātā koparaktāsyalocanaḥ || 10.23 || brahmovāca jñānaṃ te bhavatu bhraṣṭaṃ strījito bhava pāmara | sarvajātiṣu gandharvaḥ kāmī so'pi bhavānbhava || 10.24 || pañcāśatkāminīnāṃ ca svayaṃ bhartā bhavācirāth | tāsāṃ vaśaśca satataṃ strīṇāṃ krīḍā mṛgo yathā || 10.25 || śṛṅgāraśūro bhava re śaśvatsusthirayauvanaḥ | tāsāṃ nityaṃ yauvanānāṃ sundarīṇāṃ śighraṃ dāruṇaṃ ca yathocitaṃ || 10.30 || apūjyo bhava duṣṭaṃ tvaṃ tvanmantropāsakaḥ kutaḥ | agamyāgamanecchā te bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 10.31 || nāradasya tu śāpena so'pūjyo jagatāṃ vidhiḥ | dṛṣṭvā svakanyārūpaṃ ca paścāddhāvitavānpurā || 10.32 || punaḥ svadehaṃ tatyāja bhartsitaḥ sanakādibhiḥ | lajjitaḥ kāmayuktaśca punarbrahmā babhūva saḥ || 10.33 || nāradastu namaskṛtya pitaraṃ kamalodbhavaṃ | vipradehaṃ parityajya gandharvaśca babhūva saḥ || 10.34 || navayauvanakālena balavānmadanoddhataḥ | jahāra kanyāḥ pañcāśatbalāccitrarathasya tu || 10.35 || gāndharvena vivāhena tā uvāha ca nirjane | yugandhare | vane kelikadambānāṃ ketakīnāṃ manohare || 10.48 || mādhavīmālatīnāṃ ca yūthikānāṃ vane vane | campakānāṃ palāśānāṃ kundānāṃ vipine tathā || 10.49 || nāgeśvaralavaṅgānāṃ antare lalitālaye | kumudānāṃ paṅkajānāṃ paṅkile komalasthale || 10.50 || sthalapadmaprakāro ca bhūmicampakakānane | lāṅgalīnāṃ rasālānāṃ panasānāṃ sukhaprade || 10.51 || kadalībadarīṇāṃ ca śrīphalānāṃ ca śrīyute | jambīrāṇāṃ ca jambūnāṃ karañjānāṃ tathaiva ca || 10.52 || kṛtvā bihāraṃ tābhiśca gandharvaścopavarhaṇaḥ | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca svāśramaṃ punarāyayau || 10.53 || śrutvā vidhāturāhvānaṃ puṣkaraṃ ca yayau punaḥ | dadarśa tatra brahmāṇaṃ ratnasiṃhāsanasthitaṃ || 10.54 || devendraiścāpi siddhendrairmunīndraiḥ sankādibhiḥ | samāvṛtaṃ sabhāyāṃ ca rakṣogandharvakinnaraiḥ || 10.55 || suśobhitaṃ yathā candraṃ gagane bhagaṇaiḥ saha | praṇanāma sabhāmadhye tābhiḥ sārdhaṃ jagadvidhiṃ || 10.56 || maheśaṃ ca gaṇeśaṃ ca dhaneśaṃ śeṣaṃ īśvaraṃ | dharmaṃ dhanvantariṃ skandaṃ sūryasomahutāśanaṃ || 10.57 || upendrendraṃ viśvakāruṃ varuṇaṃ pavanaṃ smaraṃ | yamaṃ aṣṭau vasūnrudrānjayantaṃ nalakūvaraṃ || 10.58 || sarvāndevānnamaskṛtya nanāma munipuṅgavaṃ | agastyaṃ ca pulastyaṃ ca pulahaṃ ca pracetasaṃ || 10.59 || sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca dakṣaṃ ca kardamaṃ tathā | sanakaṃ sanandaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca sanātanaṃ || 10.60 || sanatkumāraṃ yogīśaṃ jñānināṃ ca gurorguruṃ | voḍhuṃ pañcaśikhaṃ saṅkhaṃ bhṛguṃ aṅgirasaṃ tathā || 10.61 || āsuriṃ kapilaṃ kautsaṃ kratuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ | marīciṃ kaśyapaṃ kaṇvaṃ vyāsaṃ durvāsasaṃ kaviṃ || 10.62 || bṛhaspatiṃ ca cyavanaṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ ca lomaśaṃ | vālmīkiṃ paraśurāmaṃ saṃvartaṃ ca vibhāṇḍakaṃ || 10.63 || devalaṃ ca vāmadevaṃ ṛśayaśṛṅgaṃ parāśāraṃ | etānsarvānnamaskṛtya tasthau sa purato vidheḥ || 10.64 || tuṣṭāva sarvāndevāṃśca munīndrāṃśca tathaiva ca | taṃ uvāca sabhāmadhye vidhātā jagatāṃ api | sasmitaḥ suprasannaśca gandharvaṃ upavarhaṇaṃ || 10.65 || brahmovāca śrīkṛṣṇarasasaṅgītaṃ vīṇādhvanisamanvitaṃ | kuru vatsādhunātraiva śṛṇvantu munayaḥ surāḥ || 10.66 || gopīnāṃ vastraharaṇaṃ haraṃ rāsamahotsavaṃ | tābhiḥ sārdhaṃ jalakrīḍāṃ harerutkīrtanaṃ kuru || 10.67 || kṛṣṇasaṅkīrtanaṃ tūrṇaṃ punāti śrutimātrataḥ | śrotāraṃ ca pravaktāraṃ | teṣāṃ pādarajaḥsparśātsadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā || 10.72 || tatkīrtanaṃ bhavedyatra kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ | sthānaṃ tacca bhavettīrthaṃ mṛtānāṃ tatra muktidaṃ || 10.73 || nātra pāpāni tiṣṭhanti puṇyāni susthirāṇi ca | tapasvināṃ ca vratināṃ vratānāṃ tapasāṃ sthalaṃ || 10.74 || vartate pāpināṃ dehe pāpāni trividhāni ca | mahāpāpopapāpātipāpānyeva smṛtāni ca || 10.75 || hantā yo viprabhikṣūṇāṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇāṃ | strīṇāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca sa mahāpātakī smṛtaḥ || 10.76 || bhrūṇāghnaścāpi goghnaśca śūdraghnaśca kṛtaghnakaḥ | viśvāsaghātī viḍbhojī sa eva hyupapātakī || 10.77 || agamyāgamino ye ca suraviprasvahāriṇaḥ | atipātakinaścaite vedavidbhiḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 10.78 || kṛṣṇasaṃkīrtnadhyānāttanmantragrahaṇādaho | mucyante pātakaistaistaiḥ pāpinastrividhāḥ smṛtāḥ || 10.79 || tapoyajñakṛtī pūtastīrthasnātavratī tathā | bhikṣuryatirbrahmacārī vānaprasthaśca tāpasaḥ || 10.80 || pavitraḥ paramo vahniḥ supavitraṃ jalaṃ yathā | ete sarve vaiṣṇavānāṃ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīṃ || 10.81 || viṣṇupādodakocchiṣṭaṃ bhuñjate ye ca nityaśaḥ | paśyanti ca śilācakraṃ pūjāṃ kurvanti nityaśaḥ || 10.82 || jīvanmuktāsca te dhanyā haridāsāśca bhārate | pade pade'śvamedhasya prāpnuvanti phalaṃ dhruvaṃ || 10.83 || nahi teṣāṃ parābhūtāḥ puṇyavanto jagattraye | teṣāṃ ca pādarajasā tīrthaṃ pūtaṃ tathā dharā || 10.84 | || teṣāṃ ca darśanaṃ sparśaṃ vāñchanti munayaḥ surāḥ | puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca pūtaṃ tajjanmamātrataḥ || 10.85 || ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā tatra tūṣṇīṃ babhūva saḥ | āścaryaṃ menire śrutvā devāśca munayastathā || 10.86 || etasminnantare tatra vidyādharyaḥ samāgatāḥ | gandharvāścāpi vividhā nanṛtuḥ kinnarā jaguḥ || 10.87 || rambhorvaśī ghṛtācī ca menakā ca tilottamā | sudhāmukhī pūrṇacittī mohinī kalikā tathā || 10.88 || campāvatī candramukhī padmā padmamukhīti ca | etāścānyāśca bahvyaśca śvaśvatsusthirayauvanāḥ || 10.89 || bṛhannitambaśroṇīkāstanabhāraiḥ samānatāḥ | īṣaddhāsyāḥ prasannāsyāḥ kāmārtāśca samāyayuḥ || 10.90 || vedajñā mūrtimantaśca vedāścātvāra eva ca | brāhmaṇā bhikṣavaḥ siddhā yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ || 10.91 || samāyayustathā mandā daivajñāḥ stutipāṭhakāḥ | lakṣmī sarasvatī durgā sāvitrī rohiṇī ratiḥ || 10.92 || tulasī pṛthivī gaṅgā svāhā ca yamunā tathā | vāruṇī manasendrāṇī tāḥ sarvā devayoṣitaḥ || 10.93 || munipatnyaśca gandharvyo harṣayuktāḥ samāyayuḥ | aho mahotsavaṃ paramānandamānasāḥ | vicitrāṃ ca brahmasabhāṃ puṣkaraṃ tīrthaṃ āyayuḥ || 10.94 || iti śrīnāradapañcarātre jñānāmṛtasāre prathamaikarātre mahotsavārambho nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ <11> prathamaikarātre ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ atha mahotsavadarśanam śrīvyāsa uvāca atha gandharvarājastu bhagavānājñayā vidheḥ | saṃgītaṃ ca jagau tatra kṛṣṇarāsamahotsavaṃ || 11.1 || susamaṃ tālamānaṃ ca sutānaṃ madhuraṃ śrutaṃ | vīṇāmṛdaṅgamurajayuktaṃ dhvanisamanvitaṃ || 11.2 || rāgiṇīyuktarāgeṇa samayoktena sundaraṃ | mādhuryaṃ mūrcchnāyuktaṃ manase harṣakāraṇaṃ || 11.3 || vicitraṃ nṛtyaruciraṃ rūpaveśaṃ uttamaṃ | lokānurāgabījaṃ ca nāṭyopayuktahastakaṃ || 11.4 || dṛṣṭvā śrutvā surāḥ sarve munayaḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ | mūrcchāṃ prāyuśca sahasā cetanāṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ || 11.5 || gopīnāṃ vastraharaṇaṃ gopīgaṇavilāpanaṃ | tābhyo vastrapradānaṃ ca saṃmānaṃ varadānakaṃ || 11.6 || kātyāyanīvrataṃ cāpi vipradārānnabhojanaṃ | mahendradarpapūjādi bhañjanaṃ śailapūjanaṃ || 11.7 || punaśca śuśruvuḥ sarve śrīvṛndāvanavarṇanaṃ | saṃprāpuśca punarmūrcchāṃ punaḥ prāpuśca cetanāṃ || 11.8 || tasmai dadau puro brahmā vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ paraṃ | paraṃ śubhāśīrvacanaṃ yattanmānasavāñchitaṃ || 11.9 || amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ cārukuṇḍālayugmakaṃ | maṇīndrasāramukuṭaṃ paraṃ ratnāṅgurīyakaṃ || 11.10 || sugandhi candanaṃ puṣpaṃ svapādareṇuṃ īpsitaṃ | amūlyaratnatilakaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇaṃ ujjvalaṃ || 11.11 || pratyekaṃ vastu ruciraṃ tadyoṣidbhyaśca saṃdadau | viśvakarmā ca nirmāṇamaṇiṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ uttamaṃ || 11.12 || pratyekaṃ śaṅkhasindūraṃ kastūrīyuktacandanaṃ | sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ ratnendrasāradarpaṇaṃ || 11.13 || maṇinirmāṇāmañjoraṃ śvetacāmaraśobhanaṃ | manoyāyi rathaṃ divyaṃ īsvarecchāvinirmitaṃ || 11.14 || muktāmāṇikyahīrendrairmaṇīndraiśca pariṣkṛtaṃ | sadratnamālājālaiśca śvetacāmaradarpaṇaiḥ || 11.15 || suśobhitaṃ ca parito lakṣaiḥ sundaramandiraiḥ | maṇimānikyahīrāḍhyaṃ sadratnakalaśojjvalaṃ || 11.16 || sahasracakrasaṃsaktaṃ yojanāyatasammitaṃ | dhanurlakṣocchritaṃ caiva sahasrāśvena yojitaṃ || 11.17 | etadeva dadau brahmā prahṛṣṭastuṣṭa eva ca | śambhustuṣṭo dadau hṛṣṭo haribhaktiṃ ca niścalāṃ || 11.18 || jñānaṃ adhyātmikaṃ caiva yogajñānaṃ sudurlabhaṃ | nānājanmasmṛtijñānaṃ naipuṇyaṃ sarvasiddhiṣu || 11.19 || hareścarcāvidhānaṃ ca stavanaṃ pūjanaṃ tathā | māṇikyahīrāhāraṃ ca ratnalakṣaṃ sudurlabhaṃ || 11.20 || nāgahāraṃ dadau śeṣo nāgendramaulimaṇḍanaṃ | nāgakanyāśataṃ caiva varabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaṃ || 11.21 || nāgebhyaścābhyaṃ nityaṃ hisrajantubhya eva ca | nṛpālayagatijñānaṃ sarvalokavilokanaṃ || 11.22 || nirvighnatvaṃ dadau tasmai vighnrājaśca saṃsadi | sudurlabhaṃ pādapadmayugmareṇuṃ abhīpsitaṃ || 11.23 || amūlyaṃ ca nirupamaṃ grīṣmasūryaprabhopamaṃ | maṇirājaṃ sudīptaṃ ca triṣu lokeṣu durlabhaṃ || 11.24 || sarvatra vijayaṃ caiva vāñcchitaṃ nirmalaṃ yaśaḥ | saṃgītavidyāvijñānaṃ tannaipuṇyaṃ manoharaṃ || 11.25 || lakṣasvarṇaṃ dhaneśaśca dāsānāṃ ca śataṃ śataṃ | dharmaḥ kīrtimayīṃ mālāṃ skando dhairyaṃ dadau tathā || 11.26 || viṣayajīrṇāpaharaṇaṃ dadau dhanvantarirmanuṃ | sūryaḥ syamantakamaṇiṃ gandharvaḥ prayayau tasmādyoṣidbhiḥ saha putraka | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavṛttāntaṃ eva ca || 13.35 || iti śrīnāradapañcarātre jñānāmṛtasāre prathamaikarātre gandharvamokṣaṇaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ prathamaikarātre caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ <14> śrīśuka uvāca prayāte rādhikānāthe golokaṃ ca nirāmayaṃ | babhūva kiṃ rahasyaṃ ca gate gandharvapuṅgave || 14.1 || śrīvyāsa uvāca sarve devāśca munayaḥ prayāte paramātmani | sarve babhūvuste tūṣṇīṃ vayāṃsīva dinātyaye || 14.2 || uvāca śambhurbrahmāṇaṃ nītisāraviśāradaṃ | jñānādhidevo bhagavānpariṇāmasukhaṃ vacaḥ || 14.3 || śrīmahādeva uvāca rakṣitā yasya bhagavānkalyāṇaṃ tasya santataṃ | sa yasya vighnakartā ca rakṣituṃ taṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ || 14.4 || smṛtimātreṇa nirvighnā ye ca kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ | vighnaṃ kartuṃ ke samarthāsteṣāṃ ca munayaḥ surāḥ || 14.5 || kopāgnināṃ sthalaṃ kutra stambhitānāṃ ca sāmprataṃ | devānāṃ ca munīnāṃ ca kṣaṇenaiveśvarecchayā || 14.6 || yadi tiṣṭhanti bhūmau ca dagdhaśasyā vasundharā | jale yadi tatastaptaṃ naṣṭhāste jalajantavaḥ || 14.7 || sthāle dahanti lokāṃśca vṛkṣāṃśca pralayāgnayaḥ | vidhānaṃ kartuṃ ucitaṃ eṣāṃ ca jagatāṃ vidhe || 14.8 || tvaṃ eva dhātā jagatāṃ pitā ca viṣṇurīśvaraḥ | kālāgnirudraḥ saṃhartā nedānī pralayakṣamaḥ || 14.9 || ete viṣayiṇaḥ sarve kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ | ājñāvahāśca satataṃ dikpālāśca digīśvarāḥ || 14.10 || tasyaivājñāvaho dharmaḥ sākṣī ca karmaṇāṃ nṛṇāṃ | bhramanti viṣaye śaśvanmohitā māyayā hareḥ || 14.11 || ahaṃ na pātā na sraṣṭā na saṃhartā ca jīvanāṃ | nirlipto' haṃ tapasvī ca harerārādhanonmukhaḥ || 14.12 || saṃhāraviṣayaṃ mahyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaśca purā dadau | datvā rudrāya tadahaṃ tapasyāsu rato hareḥ || 14.13 || tadarcanena dhyānena tapasā pūjanena ca | stavena kavacanenaiva nāmamantrajapena ca || 14.14 || mṛtyuñjayo' haṃ adhunā na ca kālādbhayaṃ mama | kālaḥ saṃharate sarvaṃ māṃ vinā ca tatheśvaraṃ || 14.15 || purā sarvādisarge ca kasyacitsraṣṭureva ca | bhālodbhavāśca te rudrāsteṣveko' haṃ śaṅkaraḥ || 14.16 || kalpaśca brahmaṇaḥ pāte laye prākṛtike tathā | sarve naṣṭā viṣayiṇo na bhaktāśca yatheśvaraḥ || 14.17 || asaṃkhyabrahmaṇaḥ pātaḥ kalpaścāsaṃkhya eva ca | samatītaḥ katividho bhavitā yā punaḥ punaḥ || 14.18 || śrīkṛṣṇasya nimeṣeṇa brahmaṇaḥ patanaṃ bhaveth | tatra prākṛtikāḥ sarve tirobhūtāḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 14.19 || na prākṛto na viṣayī nityadehī ca vaiṣṇavaḥ | harervareṇāmaro'haṃ śivādhārastatastataḥ || 14.20 || jalaplutaṃ ca viśvaughaṃ laye prākṛtike dhruvaṃ | ābrahmalokaparyantaṃ paraṃ kṛṣṇālayaṃ vinā || 14.21 || sarvā devyo vilīnāśca kṛṣṇaḥ satyaṃ suniścitaṃ | sarve pumāṃso līnāśca satye nitye sanātane || 14.22 || ahaṃ kṛṣṇaśca prakṛtiḥ pārṣadapravaro hareḥ | nityaṃ nityā vidyamānā goloke ca nirāmaye || 14.23 || eka īśo na dvitīya iti sarvādisargataḥ | nahi naśyanti tadbhaktāḥ prakṛtiprākṛte laye || 14.24 || tasya bhaktottamānāṃ ca satataṃ smaraṇena ca | āyurvyayo nahi bhavetkathaṃ mṛtyurbhaviṣyati || 14.25 || na vāsudevabhaktānāṃ aśubhaṃ vidyate kvacith | teṣāṃ bhaktottamānāṃ ca satataṃ smaraṇena ca || 14.26 || janmamṛtyujarāvyādhibhayaṃ nāpyupajāyate | atra kalpe bhavānbrahmā vyavasthātā ca karmasu || 14.27 || sthalaṃ kopānalānāṃ ca vidhānaṃ yadvidhe kuru | śambhośca vacanaṃ śrutvā kampitaḥ kamalāsanaḥ | sthalaṃ cakāra vahnīnāṃ ājñayā śaṅkarasya ca || 14.28 || brahmovaca jvarastripādastriśirāḥ ṣaḍbhujo navalocanaḥ | bhasmapraharaṇo raudraḥ kālāntakayamopamaḥ || 14.29 || bhave bhavatu sarvatra bhavakopānalo'dhunā | prākṛteṣu ca deheṣu vyāpāro'sya mayā kṛtaḥ || 14.30 || mama kopānalaḥ śambho saṃskṛtāgnirdvijasya ca | bhave bhavatu sarvatra vyāpāro'sya mayā kṛtaḥ || 14.31 || śeṣasya kopavahniśca śeṣāsye'stvadhunā śiva | yato viśvaṃ ca pralaye dahedgomayapiṇḍavath || 14.32 || vahnermukhyānalo viśve vyavahārāgnirīśvaraḥ | bhvatveva hi sarvatra sarveṣāṃ upakārakaḥ || 14.33 || dharmāsyakopavahniśca kṛṣṇāgniśca bhavatvayaṃ | adharmaṃ kurvatāṃ sarvaṃ dāhanaṃ ca kariṣyati || 14.34 || sūryakopānalaścāyaṃ dāvāgniśca vaneṣu ca | sthitirasya taroḥ skandhe tadbhakṣyāḥ paśupakṣiṇaḥ || 14.35 || candrakopānalo viśve kāmināṃ virahānalaḥ | dampatyorvirahe śaśvadbhakṣyati sma dvayostanuṃ || 14.36 || indrakopānalaḥ sadyo vajrāgniśca babhūva ha | upendrasyānalaścaiva vidyudeva bhvatvayaṃ || 14.37 || rudrāṇāṃ āsyavahniśca maholkāgnirbhavatvayaṃ | gaṇeśāgniḥ pṛthivyāṃ tu yathāsthāne tu tiṣṭhati || 14.38 || yatra tiṣṭhettaduṣaraṃ evaṃ evaṃ vidurbudhāḥ | skandakopānalaścaiva raṇāstrāgnirbabhūva ha || 14.39 || kāmetarāṇāṃ devānāṃ munīnāṃ ca mukhānalaḥ | jagrāhaurvamunistatra tejasi brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ || 14.40 || svadakṣiṇorau sa muniḥ saṃsthāpya vedamantrataḥ | brahmaṇaṃ ca namaskṛtya śaṅkaraṃ tapase yayau || 14.41 || kālena tasmānniḥsṛtya samudre vāḍavānalaḥ | sa babhūva purā putra paramaurvānalaḥ svayaṃ || 14.42 || kāmāgniṃ ulvaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā vicintya manasā vidhiḥ | samālocya suraiḥ sārdhaṃ munīndraiḥ saha saṃsadi || 14.43 || ajuhāva striyaḥ sarvāḥ suvratāśca pativratāḥ | āyuyuryoṣitaḥ sarvāstā ūcuḥ kamalodbhavaṃ || 14.44 || striya ūcuḥ kiṃ asmānbrūhi bhagavanśādhi naḥ karavāma kiṃ | ālocya manasā sarvaṃ dehi bhāraṃ vayaṃ striyaḥ || 14.45 || brahmovāca gṛhītvā madanāgniṃ ca maithune sukhadāyakaṃ | viśve ca yoṣitaḥ sarvāḥ śaśvatkāmā bhavantu ca || 14.46 || brahmaṇaśca vacaḥ śrutvā koparaktāsyalocanaḥ | taṃ ūcuḥ yoṣitaḥ sarvā bhayaṃ tyaktvā ca saṃsadi || 14.47 || striya ūcuḥ dhiktvāṃ jagadvidhiṃ vyarthaṃ cakāra parameśvaraḥ | apūjyo mohinīśāpātputraśāpena sāmprataṃ || 14.48 || gṛhītvā madanāgniṃ ca puruṣāśca tathā striyaḥ | nityaṃ dahanti satataṃ vāstavaṃ duḥsahaṃ paraṃ || 14.49 || tadekabhāgaḥ puruṣe tribhāgaścāpi yoṣiti | tena dugdhāḥ striyaḥ sarvāścāsmākaṃ apareṇa kiṃ || 14.50 || samarpaṇaṃ cetpuruṣe yadyasmāsu smarānalaḥ | bhasmībhūtaṃ kariṣyāmo rakṣitā ko bhavettava || 14.51 || pativratāvacaḥ śrutvā taṃ uvāca śivaḥ svayaṃ | hitaṃ satyaṃ nitisāraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvahaṃ || 14.52 || atha kulaṭotpattiḥ śrīmahādeva uvāca tyaja dvandvaṃ mahābhāga suvratābhiḥ sahādhunā | pativratānāṃ tejaśca sarvebhyaśca paraṃ bhaveth || 14.53 || nirmāṇaṃ kuru devendra kṛtyāṃ strījātiṃ īśvara | tasyai dehi duḥkhabījaṃ kāmakopānalaṃ paraṃ || 14.54 || śaṅkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā satvaraṃ jagatāṃ vidhiḥ | sasṛje tatkṣaṇaṃ mūrtiṃ strīrūpāṃ sumanoharāṃ || 14.55 || aho rūpaṃ aho veśaṃ aho asyā navaṃ vayaḥ | aho cakṣuḥ kaṭākṣaṃ ca munīnāṃ mohayanmanaḥ || 14.56 || aho kaṭhinaṃ cāru stanayugmaṃ suvartulaṃ | vicitraṃ kaṭhinaṃ sthūlaṃ śroṇiyugmaṃ ca sundaraṃ || 14.57 || nitambayugmaṃ valitaṃ cakrākāraṃ sukomalaṃ | śvetacampakavarṇābhaṃ sarvāvayaṃ īpsitaṃ || 14.58 || śaratpārvaṇakoṭīnduvinindāsyaṃ suśobhanaṃ | īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ vastreṇācchāditaṃ mudā || 14.59 || vapuḥ sukomalaṃ cālaṃ nātidīrghaṃ na vakharaṃ | vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇairbhūṣitaṃ sadā || 14.60 || dāḍimbakumudākāraṃ sāndraṃ sindūrasundaraṃ | kastūrīvindunā sārdhaṃ snigdhacandanavindubhiḥ || 14.61 || pakvabimbaphalākāraṃ adharauṣṭhapuṭaṃ paraṃ | dantapaṃktiyugaṃ caiva dāḍimbabījasannibhaṃ || 14.62 || sucāru kavarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyamaṇḍitaṃ | tasyai dadau ca kāmāgniṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ kamalodbhavaḥ || 14.63 || dṛṣṭvā sā candrarūpaṃ ca kāmonmattā vicetanā | kṛtvā kaṭākṣaṃ smerāśyā māṃ bhajasvetyuvāca sā || 14.64 || saspitaḥ prayayau candro lajjayā ca sabhātalāth | kāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca cakame kāmārtā sā gatatrapā || 14.65 || dudrāva kāmastasmācca tatpaścātsā dadhāva ca | jahasurdevatāḥ sarvā munayaścāpi saṃsadi || 14.66 || lajjitā yoṣitahsarvāstāṃ vārayituṃ akṣamāḥ | sarve cakruḥ parīhāsaṃ strīvargaṃ śaṅkarādayaḥ || 14.67 || kāmaṃ na labdhvā sā ca strī nivṛtyāgatya saṃsadi | taṃ aśvinīkumāraṃ cāpyuvāca surasannidhau || 14.68 || kṛtyākāminyuvāca māṃ bhajasva raveḥ putra priyāṃ rasavatīṃ mudā | śṛṅgāre sukhadāṃ śāntāṃ parāṃ kāmāturāṃ varāṃ || 14.69 || tvayā śārdhaṃ bhramiṣyāmi sundare gahane vane | rahasi rahasi krīḍāṃ kariṣyāmi divāniśaṃ || 14.70 || madhupānaṃ ca dāsyāmi vāsitaṃ cāmalaṃ jalaṃ | sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ bhogavastu manoharaṃ || 14.71 || śayyāṃ manoramāṃ kṛtvā sapuṣpacandanārcitāṃ | bhagavantaṃ kariṣyāmi puṣpacandanacarcitaṃ || 14.72 || kumāra uvāca vacanaṃ vada vāme māṃ ātmano hṛdayaṅgama | vihāya kapaṭaṃ kānte kapaṭaṃ dharmanāśanaṃ || 14.73 || strīdharmaṃ strīmanaskāmaṃ strīsvabhāvaṃ ca kīdṛśaṃ | tadācāraṃ katividhaṃ tanmāṃ vyākhyātuṃ arhasi || 14.74 || aśvinījavacaḥ śrutvā kāmārtā taṃ uvāca sā | kāmārtānāṃ kva lajjā ca kva bhayaṃ mānaṃ eva ca || 14.75 || atha kulaṭāsvabhāvakathanam kāminyuvāca sthānaṃ nāsti kṣaṇaṃ nāsti nāsti dūtī taduttamā | tenaiva yuvatīnāṃ ca satītvaṃ upajāyate || 14.76 || suveśaṃ kāmukaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāminī madanāturā | tadrātraṃ ca pulakitaṃ yonau kaṇḍūyanaṃ paraṃ || 14.77 || vicetanā bhavetsā ca kāmajvaraprapīḍitā | sarvaṃ tyajati taddhetoḥ putraṃ kāntaṃ gṛhaṃ dhanaṃ || 14.78 | || labdhvā yuvānaṃ puruṣaṃ deśatyāgaṃ karoti sā | taduttamaṃ punarlabdhvā taṃ tyajetsā kṣaṇena ca || 14.79 || viṣaṃ dātuṃ samarthā sā svāminaṃ guṇināṃ varaṃ | mlecchaṃ yuvānaṃ samprāpya sarvasvaṃ dātuṃ utsukā || 14.80 || tyajetkulabhayaṃ lajjāṃ dharmaṃ bandhuṃ yaśaḥ śriyaṃ | samprāpya ratiśūraṃ ca yuvānaṃ suratonmukhaṃ || 14.81 || sudṛśyaṃ sundaramukhaṃ śaśvanmadhuritaṃ vacaḥ | hṛdayaṃ kṣuradhārābhaṃ ko vā jānāti tanmanaḥ || 14.82 || vidyucchaṭā jale rekhā cāsthirā ca yathāmbare | tathāsthirā ca kulaṭāprītiḥ svapnaṃ ca tadvacaḥ || 14.83 || kulaṭānāṃ na satyaṃ ca na ca dharmo bhayaṃ dayā | na laukikaṃ na lajjā syājjārajintā nirantaraṃ || 14.84 || svapne jāgaraṇe caiva bhojane śayane sadā | nirantaraṃ kāmacintā jāre sneho na cānyataḥ || 14.85 || kulaṭā naraghātibhyo nirdayā duṣṭamānasāḥ | jārārthe ca sutaṃ hanti bāndhavasya ca kā kathā || 14.86 || na hi vedā vidantyevaṃ kulatāhṛdayaṅgamaṃ | kathaṃ devāsca munayaḥ santo jānanti niścayaṃ || 14.87 || ratiśūraṃ priyaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ ivācareth | gate vayasi jīrṇaṃ taṃ viṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā tyajetkṣaṇāth || 14.88 || na viśvaseyustāṃ duṣṭo tasmātsanto hi santataṃ | na ripuḥ puruṣāṇāṃ ca duṣṭastrībhyaḥ paro bhuvi || 14.89 || viṣaṃ mantrādupaśamaṃ jalādvahniśca niścitaṃ | agneśca kaṇṭhakocchannaṃ durjanaḥ stavanādvaśaḥ || 14.90 || lubdho dhanena rājā ca sevayā satataṃ vaśaḥ | miśraṃ svacchasvabhāvena bhayena ca ripurvaśaḥ || 14.91 || ādareṇa vaśo vipro yauvatī premabhārataḥ | bandhurvaśaḥ samatayā guruḥ praṇatibhiḥ sadā || 14.92 || mūrkho vaśaḥ kathāyāṃ ca vidvānvidyāvicārataḥ | na hi duṣṭā ca kulaṭā puṃsaśca vaśagā bhaveth || 14.93 || svakārye tatparā śaśvatprītiḥ kāryānurodhataḥ | na sarvasya vaśībhūtā vinā śṛṅgāraṃ ulvaṇaṃ || 14.94 || na prītyā na dhanenaiva na stavānna sevayā | na prāṇadānato veśyā vaśībhūtā bhavetkṣaṇaṃ || 14.95 || āhāro dviguṇastāsāṃ buddhistāsāṃ caturguṇā | ṣaḍguṇā mantraṇā tāsāṃ kāmaścāṣṭagunaḥ smṛtaḥ || 14.96 || śaśvatkāmā ca kulaṭā na ca tṛptiśca krīḍayā | haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmeva bhūya evābhivardhate || 14.97 || divāniśaṃ ca śṛṅgāraṃ kurute tatpumānyadi | na tṛptiḥ kulaṭānāṃ ca pumāṃsaṃ grastuṃ icchati || 14.98 || nāgnistṛpyati kāṣṭhānāṃ nāpagānāṃ mahodadhiḥ | nāntakaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ nāsāṃ tṛpyati sampadāṃ || 14.99 || na śreyasāṃ manastṛptaṃ vāḍavāgnirna pāthasāṃ | vasundharā na rajasāṃ na puṃsāṃ kulaṭā tathā || 14.100 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ kiṃcithsarvaṃ vaktuṃ ca nocitaṃ | lajjā bījaṃ yoṣitāṃ ca nibodha bhāskarātmaja || 14.101 || śrutvā ca kṛtyāstrīvākyaṃ jahasurmunayaḥ surāḥ | cukupuryoṣitaḥ sarvāḥ padmādyā lajjitāḥ suta || 14.102 || lajjānatānanā lakṣmīrniryayau devamaṇḍalāth | tatpaścātpārvatī sārdhaṃ sarasvatyā natānanā || 14.103 || sāvitrī rohinī svāhā vāruṇī ca ratiḥ śacī | sarvā babhūvurekatra pracakrurmantraṇāṃ ca tāḥ || 14.104 || kṛtyāstriyaḥ samāhūya tā ūcuśca krameṇa ca | rodhayāṃ āsuriṣṭāṃ tāṃ sugopyāṃ api yoṣitaḥ || 14.105 || tasyā mukhe dadau hastaṃ suśīlā kamalālayā | salajjitā bhava sute śāntā ceti śubhāśiṣaṃ || 14.106 || sarasvatī dadau tasyai cābhimānaṃ ca dhairyatāṃ | maukharyaṃ vāvadūkatvaṃ mantraṇāṃ ātmarakṣaṇaṃ || 14.107 || sāvitrī ca dadau tasyai sauśīlyaṃ cātidurlabhaṃ | ātmasaṃgopanaṃ caiva gāmbhīryaṃ kulato bhayaṃ || 14.108 || pārvatyuvāca dhiktvāṃ svabhāvakulaṭāṃ lajjitā bhava sundari | svamānaṃ gauravaṃ rakṣa hyasmākaṃ ca smarātura || 14.109 || jani labha pṛthivyāṃ ca kāyavyūhaṃ vidhāya ca | puṃsāṃ aṣṭaguṇaṃ kāmaṃ labhasva ca pṛthakprṛthak || 14.110 || lajjāṃ caturguṇāṃ cāpi dviguṇāṃ dhairyatāṃ tathā | abhogecchadhame gaccha dūraṃ gaccha mamāntikāth || 14.111 || puṃsāṃ ca dviguṇaḥ kāmo vāstavīṇāṃ ca yoṣitāṃ | lajjā cāṣṭaguṇā cāpi dhairyatā ca caturguṇā || 14.112 || kuladharmaḥ kulabhayaṃ sauśīlyaṃ mānaṃ ūrjitaṃ | śaśvattiṣṭhatu puṃsyeva strīṣu ca mamājñayā || 14.113 || yasmātsadasi sarvebhyo lajjāhīnaḥ surādhamaḥ | strīsvabhāvaṃ ca papraccha yajñabhākna bhavettataḥ || 14.114 || adyaprabhṛti viśveṣu nāgrāhyaṃ pāpasaṃyutaṃ | cikitsakānāṃ viduṣāṃ na bhakṣya mamājñayā || 14.115 || ityevaṃ uktvā prayayurdevyaśca sarvayoṣitaḥ | devāśca munayaścāpi ye cānye ca samāgataḥ || 14.116 || devāśca munayaścāpi ye cānye sarvataḥ suta | pativratāṇāṃ strīṇāṃ ca lajjā bījasvarūpiṇī || 14.117 || iti śrīnāradapañcarātre jñāṇāmṛtasāre prathamaikarātre kulaṭottpatirnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ <15> prathamaikarātre pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ gate niyamite kāle gandharvaścopavarhaṇaḥ | svayogena jahau dehaṃ bhārate prāktanādaho || 15.1 || sa jajñe śudrayonau ca pituḥ śāpena ca daivataḥ | viṣṇuprasādaṃ bhuktvā ca babhūva brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ || 15.2 || vimuktastātaśāpena samprāpya jñānaṃ uttamaṃ | pratijanmasmṛtistasya kṛṣṇamantraprasādataḥ || 15.3 || pituḥ sakāśādāgatya samprāpa candraśekharāth | śrīkṛṣṇamantraṃ atulaṃ svargamandākinītaṭe || 15.4 || svargamandākinītīrādguruṇā śaṅkareṇa ca | sahitaḥ prayayau tūrṇaṃ pārvatīsannidhānataḥ || 15.5 || uvāsa tatra śambhuśca nāradaśca mahāmuniḥ | pārvatī bhadrakālī skando gaṇapatiḥ svayaṃ || 15.6 || mahākālaśca nandī ca vīrabhadraḥ pratāpavān | siddhā maharṣayaśca munayaḥ sankādayaḥ || 15.7 || yogīndrā jñāninaḥ sarve samūcuḥ śambhusaṃsadi | yatstotraṃ kavacaṃ dhyānaṃ subhadrāya ca kānane || 15.8 || nārāyaṇarṣibhagavānbrāhmaṇāya dadau purā | pūjāvidhānaṃ yadyacca puraścaraṇapūrvakaṃ || 15.9 || tadeva bhagavānśambhuḥ pradadau nāradāya ca | uvāca śambhuṃ devarṣiryogināṃ ca gurorguruṃ | pārvatīsannidhau tatra nāradaśca mahāmuniḥ || 15.10 || bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvajña sarvakāraṇa | sadyatpṛṣṭaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ tanmāṃ vyākhyātuṃ arhasi || 15.11 || yadyatpṛṣṭaṃ tvayā brahmanpratyekaṃ ca krameṇa ca | punaḥ praśnaṃ kuru mune śṛṇvantu matsabhāsadaḥ || 15.12 || ādhyātmikaṃ ca yajjñānaṃ vedānāṃ sāraṃ uttamaṃ | jñānaṃ jñāniṣu sāraṃ yatkṛṣṇabhaktipradaṃ śubhaṃ || 15.13 || nirvāṇamuktidaṃ jñānaṃ karmamūlanikṛntanaṃ | tatsiddhiyogānmuktiśca yogināṃ api vāñcchitaṃ || 15.14 || saṃsāraviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ śaśvatsammohaveṣṭitaṃ | āśramāṇāṃ samācāraṃ teṣāṃ dharmapariṣkṛtaṃ || 15.15 || caturṇāṃ varṇanāṃ vidhānāṃ maheśvara | bhikṣūṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇāṃ || 15.16 || vānaprasthāśramāṇāṃ ca paṇḍitānāṃ tathaiva ca | pativratānāṃ yadyacca śrīkṛṣṇapūjanaṃ ca yath || 15.17 || yatstotraṃ kavacaṃ mantraṃ puraścaraṇaṃ īpsitaṃ | sārvāhnikaṃ abhīṣṭaṃ ca vipākaṃ karmajīvināṃ || 15.18 || saṃsāravāsanābaddhaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ prakṛtīśayoḥ | tayoḥ paraṃ vā yadbrahma tasyāvatāravarṇanaṃ || 15.19 || kastatkalāvatīrṇaśca kastadaṃśaśtathaiva ca | paripūrṇatamaḥ kaśca kaḥ pūrṇaḥ kaḥ kalāṃśakaḥ || 15.20 || kasya vārādhane śambho kiṃ phalaṃ kiṃ yaśastathā | aṅgāṅginorbhedaphalaṃ vistīrṇaṃ nirapekṣakaṃ || 15.21 || nārāyaṇarṣikavacaṃ subhadrabrāhmaṇāya ca | yaddattaṃ kiṃ taddeveśa tadārādhyaśca kaḥ suraḥ || 15.22 || atisaṃgopanīyaṃ ca kavacaṃ paramādbhutaṃ | sudurlabhaṃ ca viśveṣu noktaṃ māṃ brahmaṇā purā || 15.23 || sanatkumāro jānāti noktaṃ tena purā ca māṃ | mayā jñānaṃ anāpṛṣṭaṃ yadyajjānāsi maṅgalaṃ || 15.24 || vedasāraṃ anupamaṃ karmamūlanikṛntanaṃ | tanme kathaya bhadreśa māṃ evānugrahaṃ kuru || 15.25 || apūrvaṃ rādhikākhyānaṃ vedeṣu ca sudurlabhaṃ | purāṇeṣvitihāse ca vedāṅgeṣu sudurlabhaṃ || 15.26 || gurośca jñānodigaraṇātjñānaṃ syānmantratantrayoḥ | tattantaṃ sa ca mantraḥ syātkṛṣṇabhaktiryato bhaveth || 15.27 || jñānaṃ syādviduṣāṃ kiṃcidvedavyākhyānataḥ prabho | vedakāraṇapūjyaśtvaṃ jñānādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā || 15.28 || tasmādbhavānparaṃ jñānaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara | māṃ bhaktaṃ anuraktaṃ ca śaraṇāgataṃ īśvara || 15.29 || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā yogināṃ ca gurorguruḥ | bhagavatyā sahālocya jñānaṃ vaktuṃ samudyataḥ || 15.30 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvākhyānaṃ manoharaṃ | haribhaktipradaṃ sarvaṃ karmamūlanikṛntanaṃ || 15.31 ||
